verses.1:1: These are the words Moses spoke to all Israel across the Jordan, in the wilderness, in the Arabah facing Suph, between Paran and Tophel, and Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
verses.1:2: It is an eleven-day journey from Horeb along the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.
verses.1:3: It came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first of the month, that Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to everything the LORD had commanded him concerning them,
verses.1:4: after he had struck down Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan, who dwelt in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.
verses.1:5: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses undertook to expound this law, saying:
verses.1:6: The LORD our God spoke to us at Horeb, saying, "You have dwelt at this mountain long enough.
verses.1:7: Turn and set out on your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all its neighboring regions, in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the Negev, and along the seacoast—the land of the Canaanites and Lebanon, as far as the great river, the River Euphrates.
verses.1:8: Behold, I have set the land before you; go in and take possession of the land which the LORD swore to your fathers—to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—to give to them and to their seed after them."
verses.1:9: And I spoke to you at that time, saying, "I am not able to bear you by myself.
verses.1:10: The LORD your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are this day as the stars of heaven in multitude.
verses.1:11: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, increase you a thousand times as many as you are, and bless you just as He has promised you!
verses.1:12: How can I by myself bear your trouble, your burden, and your strife?
verses.1:13: Choose for yourselves wise, discerning, and well-known men from your tribes, and I will appoint them as heads over you."
verses.1:14: And you answered me and said, "The thing that you have spoken is good to do."
verses.1:15: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and well-known men, and appointed them as heads over you: commanders of thousands, commanders of hundreds, commanders of fifties, commanders of tens, and officers for your tribes.
verses.1:16: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, "Hear the cases between your brethren, and judge righteously between a man and his brother, or the sojourner who is with him.
verses.1:17: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small as well as the great. You shall not be afraid of the face of any man, for the judgment belongs to God. And the case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it."
verses.1:18: And I commanded you at that time all the things that you should do.
verses.1:19: Then we set out from Horeb and journeyed through all that great and fearsome wilderness which you saw, by way of the hill country of the Amorites, as the LORD our God had commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.
verses.1:20: And I said to you, "You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God is giving us.
verses.1:21: Behold, the LORD your God has set the land before you; go up and take possession of it, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has spoken to you. Do not fear, and do not be dismayed."
verses.1:22: Then all of you came near to me and said, "Let us send men before us, that they may search out the land for us and bring back word to us concerning the way by which we should go up, and the cities to which we shall come."
verses.1:23: And the word seemed good in my eyes, so I took twelve men from among you, one man from each tribe.
verses.1:24: And they turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the Valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.
verses.1:25: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands and brought it down to us; and they brought back word to us and said, "It is a good land that the LORD our God is giving us."
verses.1:26: Yet you were not willing to go up, but rebelled against the command of the LORD your God.
verses.1:27: And you murmured in your tents and said, "Because the LORD hated us, He has brought us out of the land of Egypt to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.1:28: Where are we going up? Our brethren have made our hearts melt, saying, 'The people are greater and taller than we; the cities are great and fortified up to heaven; moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there.'"
verses.1:29: Then I said to you, "Do not be terrified, nor be afraid of them.
verses.1:30: The LORD your God, who goes before you, He Himself will fight for you, according to all that He did for you in Egypt before your eyes,
verses.1:31: and in the wilderness where you saw how the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his own son, through all the way that you walked until you came to this place."
verses.1:32: Yet in this matter you did not trust in the LORD your God,
verses.1:33: who went before you along the way to seek out a place for you to encamp, in fire by night to show you the way in which you should walk, and in a cloud by day.
verses.1:34: And the LORD heard the sound of your words, and was angry and swore, saying,
verses.1:35: "Surely not one of these men, this evil generation, shall see the good land that I swore to give to your fathers,
verses.1:36: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him and to his children I will give the land on which he has walked, because he has wholly followed the LORD."
verses.1:37: The LORD was also angry with me on your account, saying, "You also shall not enter there.
verses.1:38: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, he shall go in there. Strengthen him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.1:39: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would become plunder, and your children, who this day do not know good from evil, they shall enter there; to them I will give it, and they shall possess it.
verses.1:40: But as for you, turn back and journey into the wilderness by way of the Red Sea."
verses.1:41: Then you answered and said to me, "We have sinned against the LORD; we ourselves will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us." And every man of you girded on his weapons of war, and you deemed it an easy thing to go up into the hill country.
verses.1:42: And the LORD said to me, "Say to them, 'Do not go up, nor fight, for I am not in your midst, lest you be struck down before your enemies.'"
verses.1:43: So I spoke to you, yet you would not listen; rather you rebelled against the command of the LORD, and acted presumptuously and went up into the hill country.
verses.1:44: Then the Amorites who dwelt in that hill country came out against you and pursued you as bees do, and beat you down in Seir as far as Hormah.
verses.1:45: And you returned and wept before the LORD, but the LORD would not listen to your voice, nor give ear to you.
verses.1:46: So you remained in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you dwelt there.
verses.2:1: Then we turned and journeyed into the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea, as the LORD spoke to me, and we skirted Mount Seir for many days.
verses.2:2: And the LORD spoke to me, saying,
verses.2:3: "You have skirted this mountain long enough; turn yourselves northward.
verses.2:4: And command the people, saying, 'You are about to pass through the territory of your brethren, the sons of Esau, who dwell in Seir, and they will be afraid of you; therefore guard yourselves carefully.
verses.2:5: Do not contend with them, for I will not give you any of their land, not even so much as the tread of the sole of a foot, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau as a possession.
verses.2:6: You shall buy food from them with silver, that you may eat; and you shall also purchase water from them with silver, that you may drink.'"
verses.2:7: For the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hand; He knows your journeying through this great wilderness. These forty years the LORD your God has been with you; you have lacked nothing.
verses.2:8: So we passed beyond our brethren, the sons of Esau, who dwell in Seir, away from the road of the Arabah, from Elath and from Ezion Geber; and we turned and passed along the way of the Wilderness of Moab.
verses.2:9: Then the LORD said to me, "Do not harass Moab, nor contend with them in battle, for I will not give you any of their land as a possession, because I have given Ar to the sons of Lot as a possession."
verses.2:10: The Emim dwelt there formerly, a people great and numerous and tall as the Anakim.
verses.2:11: They also were reckoned as Rephaim, like the Anakim, but the Moabites call them Emim.
verses.2:12: The Horites also dwelt in Seir formerly, but the sons of Esau dispossessed them and destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their place, just as Israel did to the land of their possession which the LORD gave to them.
verses.2:13: "Now arise and cross over the Brook Zered." So we crossed over the Brook Zered.
verses.2:14: And the time that we journeyed from Kadesh Barnea until we crossed over the Brook Zered was thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the midst of the camp, just as the LORD had sworn to them.
verses.2:15: Moreover, the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from the midst of the camp until they were wholly consumed.
verses.2:16: So it came to pass, when all the men of war had finished dying from the midst of the people,
verses.2:17: that the LORD spoke to me, saying,
verses.2:18: "This day you are to pass over the border of Moab at Ar.
verses.2:19: And when you draw near opposite the sons of Ammon, do not harass them nor contend with them, for I will not give you any of the land of the sons of Ammon as a possession, because I have given it to the sons of Lot as a possession."
verses.2:20: That also was reckoned a land of Rephaim; Rephaim dwelt there formerly, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,
verses.2:21: a people great and numerous and tall as the Anakim. Yet the LORD destroyed them from before them, and they dispossessed them and dwelt in their place,
verses.2:22: just as He did for the sons of Esau, who dwell in Seir, when He destroyed the Horites from before them, and they dispossessed them and dwelt in their place to this day.
verses.2:23: And as for the Avvim, who dwelt in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorim, who came forth from Caphtor, destroyed them and dwelt in their place.
verses.2:24: "Arise, set out, and cross over the Valley of the Arnon. Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
verses.2:25: This day I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you upon the peoples under all the heavens, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you."
verses.2:26: And I sent messengers from the Wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
verses.2:27: "Let me pass through your land; I will keep strictly to the highway, and I will not turn aside to the right or to the left.
verses.2:28: You shall sell me food for silver, that I may eat, and give me water for silver, that I may drink; only let me pass through on foot,
verses.2:29: just as the sons of Esau who dwell in Seir and the Moabites who dwell in Ar did for me, until I cross over the Jordan into the land which the LORD our God is giving us."
verses.2:30: But Sihon king of Heshbon was not willing to let us pass through his land, for the LORD your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, that He might deliver him into your hand, as it is this day.
verses.2:31: And the LORD said to me, "Behold, I have begun to deliver Sihon and his land before you; begin to possess it, that you may inherit his land."
verses.2:32: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.
verses.2:33: And the LORD our God delivered him over before us, and we struck down him and his sons and all his people.
verses.2:34: We captured all his cities at that time and utterly destroyed every city—men, women, and little ones; we left no survivor.
verses.2:35: Only the livestock we took as plunder for ourselves, along with the spoil of the cities which we had captured.
verses.2:36: From Aroer, which is on the rim of the Valley of the Arnon, and from the city that is in the valley, even as far as Gilead, there was not a single town that was too high for us; the LORD our God delivered them all before us.
verses.2:37: Only you did not draw near to the land of the sons of Ammon, nor to any part along the side of the Brook Jabbok, nor to the cities of the hill country, nor to anything which the LORD our God had commanded.
verses.3:1: Then we turned and went up by the way to Bashan; and Og king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.3:2: And the LORD said to me, "Do not fear him, for I have delivered him and all his people and his land into your hand; and you shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon."
verses.3:3: So the LORD our God delivered into our hand Og king of Bashan also, and all his people, and we struck him down until no survivor was left to him.
verses.3:4: And we captured all his cities at that time; there was not a town which we did not take from them—sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.3:5: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, besides very many unwalled towns.
verses.3:6: And we utterly destroyed them, just as we had done to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every city—men, women, and little ones.
verses.3:7: But all the livestock and the spoil of the cities we took as plunder for ourselves.
verses.3:8: Thus at that time we took the land from the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the Valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.
verses.3:9: The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.
verses.3:10: All the cities of the tableland, all Gilead, and all Bashan, as far as Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.3:11: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron—is it not in Rabbah of the sons of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length and four cubits its width, according to the cubit of a man.
verses.3:12: And this land, which we took in possession at that time, from Aroer, which is by the Valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
verses.3:13: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of the Rephaim.
verses.3:14: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them—that is, Bashan—after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.
verses.3:15: And to Machir I gave Gilead.
verses.3:16: And to the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the Valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley being the border, and as far as the Brook Jabbok, the border of the sons of Ammon;
verses.3:17: the Arabah also, with the Jordan as the border, from Chinnereth as far as the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, beneath the slopes of Pisgah on the east.
verses.3:18: Then I commanded you at that time, saying, "The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it. You shall cross over armed before your brethren, the children of Israel, all men of valor.
verses.3:19: Only your wives, your little ones, and your livestock—I know that you have much livestock—shall remain in your cities which I have given you,
verses.3:20: until the LORD gives rest to your brethren as to you, and they also possess the land which the LORD your God is giving them beyond the Jordan; then each man of you shall return to his possession which I have given you."
verses.3:21: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, "Your own eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings; so will the LORD do to all the kingdoms into which you are crossing over.
verses.3:22: You shall not fear them, for it is the LORD your God who fights for you."
verses.3:23: And I pleaded with the LORD at that time, saying,
verses.3:24: "O Lord GOD, You have begun to show Your servant Your greatness and Your mighty hand; for what god is there in heaven or on earth who can do according to Your works and according to Your mighty deeds?
verses.3:25: Let me cross over, I pray, and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, this good hill country and Lebanon."
verses.3:26: But the LORD was angry with me on your account and would not listen to me; and the LORD said to me, "Enough for you! Speak to Me no more of this matter.
verses.3:27: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, northward, southward, and eastward, and behold it with your eyes; for you shall not cross over this Jordan.
verses.3:28: But charge Joshua, and encourage him and strengthen him; for he shall cross over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see."
verses.3:29: So we remained in the valley opposite Beth Peor.
verses.4:1: And now, O Israel, listen to the statutes and the judgments which I am teaching you to perform, that you may live, and enter in and possess the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, is giving you.
verses.4:2: You shall not add to the word which I command you, nor take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I am commanding you.
verses.4:3: Your own eyes have seen what the LORD did at Baal Peor; for every man who went after Baal Peor, the LORD your God destroyed him from your midst.
verses.4:4: But you who held fast to the LORD your God are alive, all of you, this day.
verses.4:5: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, just as the LORD my God commanded me, so that you may do accordingly in the midst of the land which you are entering to possess.
verses.4:6: Observe them therefore and perform them, for that is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples, who shall hear all these statutes and say, "Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people."
verses.4:7: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to it as the LORD our God is, whenever we call upon Him?
verses.4:8: And what great nation is there that has statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law which I set before you this day?
verses.4:9: Only take heed to yourself, and guard your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes have seen, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; and make them known to your children and to your children's children—
verses.4:10: the day when you stood before the LORD your God at Horeb, when the LORD said to me, "Assemble the people to Me, and I will cause them to hear My words, that they may learn to fear Me all the days that they live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children."
verses.4:11: Then you drew near and stood at the foot of the mountain, while the mountain burned with fire to the very heart of heaven, with darkness, cloud, and thick gloom.
verses.4:12: And the LORD spoke to you from the midst of the fire. You heard the sound of words, yet saw no form; there was only a voice.
verses.4:13: So He declared to you His covenant which He commanded you to perform, the Ten Commandments; and He wrote them upon two tablets of stone.
verses.4:14: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that you might perform them in the land into which you are crossing over to possess.
verses.4:15: Therefore guard your souls very carefully, for you saw no form on the day when the LORD spoke to you at Horeb from the midst of the fire,
verses.4:16: lest you act corruptly and make for yourselves a carved image in the form of any figure: the likeness of male or female,
verses.4:17: the likeness of any beast that is upon the earth, or the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the heavens,
verses.4:18: the likeness of anything that creeps upon the ground, or the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth;
verses.4:19: and lest you lift up your eyes toward heaven, and when you see the sun, the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, you be led astray and bow down to them and serve them—which the LORD your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole heaven.
verses.4:20: But the LORD took you and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be a people of His own inheritance, as you are this day.
verses.4:21: Furthermore, the LORD was angry with me on your account, and swore that I should not cross over the Jordan, and that I should not enter that good land which the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.
verses.4:22: For I must die in this land; I am not crossing over the Jordan. But you shall cross over and take possession of this good land.
verses.4:23: Take heed to yourselves, lest you forget the covenant of the LORD your God which He made with you, and make for yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which the LORD your God has forbidden you.
verses.4:24: For the LORD your God is a consuming fire—a jealous God.
verses.4:25: When you father children and grandchildren, and have grown old in the land, and act corruptly and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do evil in the sight of the LORD your God to provoke Him to anger,
verses.4:26: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day that you shall surely and swiftly perish from the land which you are crossing the Jordan to possess; you shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.4:27: And the LORD shall scatter you among the peoples, and you shall remain few in number among the nations where the LORD will drive you.
verses.4:28: And there you shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see nor hear nor eat nor smell.
verses.4:29: Yet from there you will seek the LORD your God, and you shall find Him, if you search for Him with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.4:30: When you are in distress, and all these things come upon you in the latter days, you shall return to the LORD your God and obey His voice.
verses.4:31: For the LORD your God is a merciful God; He will not forsake you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which He swore to them.
verses.4:32: For ask now concerning the former days that were before you, since the day God created man upon the earth, and from one end of heaven to the other: has anything so great as this ever come to pass, or has anything like it ever been heard?
verses.4:33: Has any people ever heard the voice of God speaking from the midst of the fire, as you yourself have heard, and lived?
verses.4:34: Or has any god ever attempted to go and take for himself a nation from the midst of another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.4:35: To you it was shown, that you might know that the LORD, He is God; there is no other besides Him.
verses.4:36: Out of heaven He caused you to hear His voice, that He might discipline you; and upon the earth He showed you His great fire, and you heard His words from the midst of the fire.
verses.4:37: And because He loved your fathers, He chose their descendants after them; and He brought you out of Egypt with His own presence, by His great power,
verses.4:38: to drive out from before you nations greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, and to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.
verses.4:39: Know therefore this day, and lay it to your heart, that the LORD, He is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath; there is no other.
verses.4:40: Therefore you shall keep His statutes and His commandments which I command you this day, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days upon the land which the LORD your God is giving you for all time.
verses.4:41: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the rising of the sun,
verses.4:42: that the manslayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally, without having hated him in times past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:
verses.4:43: Bezer in the wilderness, in the tableland, for the Reubenites; Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.
verses.4:44: Now this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.
verses.4:45: These are the testimonies, the statutes, and the judgments which Moses spoke to the children of Israel after they came out of Egypt,
verses.4:46: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck down after they came out of Egypt.
verses.4:47: And they took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the rising of the sun,
verses.4:48: from Aroer, which is on the bank of the Valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Sion, that is, Hermon,
verses.4:49: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the Sea of the Arabah, beneath the slopes of Pisgah.
verses.5:1: And Moses summoned all Israel and said to them, "Hear, O Israel, the statutes and the judgments which I speak in your hearing this day, that you may learn them and take care to perform them.
verses.5:2: The LORD our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.
verses.5:3: It was not with our fathers that the LORD made this covenant, but with us—we who are here this day, all of us alive.
verses.5:4: Face to face the LORD spoke with you on the mountain from the midst of the fire.
verses.5:5: I stood between the LORD and you at that time to declare to you the word of the LORD—for you were afraid because of the fire and did not ascend the mountain—saying,
verses.5:6: 'I am the LORD your God, who brought you forth from the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.5:7: You shall have no other gods in My presence.
verses.5:8: You shall not make for yourself a carved image, any likeness of what is in heaven above, or in the earth beneath, or in the waters under the earth.
verses.5:9: You shall not bow down to them nor serve them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,
verses.5:10: and showing lovingkindness to thousands, to those who love Me and observe My commandments.
verses.5:11: You shall not take up the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not hold guiltless the one who takes up His name in vain.
verses.5:12: Observe the Sabbath day, to sanctify it, just as the LORD your God has commanded you.
verses.5:13: Six days you shall labor and perform all your work,
verses.5:14: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God. You shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your manservant, nor your maidservant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your sojourner who is within your gates—so that your manservant and your maidservant may rest just as you do.
verses.5:15: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God brought you forth from there with a mighty hand and with an outstretched arm; therefore the LORD your God has commanded you to observe the Sabbath day.
verses.5:16: Honor your father and your mother, just as the LORD your God has commanded you, that your days may be prolonged and that it may go well with you upon the land which the LORD your God is giving you.
verses.5:17: And you shall not commit adultery.
verses.5:20: And you shall not testify against your neighbor as a false witness.
verses.5:21: And you shall not covet the wife of your neighbor, nor shall you desire the house of your neighbor, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.'
verses.5:22: These words the LORD spoke to all your assembly at the mountain from the midst of the fire, the cloud, and the thick darkness, with a great voice, and He added no more. And He wrote them upon two tablets of stone and gave them to me.
verses.5:23: And it came to pass, when you heard the voice from the midst of the darkness while the mountain burned with fire, that you drew near to me, all the heads of your tribes and your elders;
verses.5:24: and you said, 'Behold, the LORD our God has shown us His glory and His greatness, and we have heard His voice from the midst of the fire. This day we have seen that God may speak with man, and yet he lives.
verses.5:25: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us; if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any longer, then we shall die.
verses.5:26: For who of all flesh has heard the voice of the living God speaking from the midst of the fire, as we have, and has lived?
verses.5:27: You draw near and hear all that the LORD our God may say, and you speak to us all that the LORD our God speaks to you, and we will hear it and do it.'
verses.5:28: And the LORD heard the sound of your words when you spoke to me, and the LORD said to me, 'I have heard the sound of the words of this people which they have spoken to you; they have done well in all that they have spoken.
verses.5:29: Oh, that they had such a heart in them, to fear Me and to keep all My commandments all their days, that it might go well with them and with their children forever!
verses.5:30: Go and say to them, "Return to your tents."
verses.5:31: But as for you, stand here beside Me, and I will speak to you all the commandment, the statutes, and the judgments which you shall teach them, that they may perform them in the land which I am giving them to possess.'
verses.5:32: Therefore you shall take care to do just as the LORD your God has commanded you; you shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.5:33: You shall walk in all the way which the LORD your God has commanded you, that you may live, and that it may go well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess."
verses.6:1: Now this is the commandment—the statutes and the judgments—which the LORD your God has commanded to teach you, that you may perform them in the land into which you are crossing over to possess it,
verses.6:2: that you may fear the LORD your God, to keep all His statutes and His commandments which I command you—you and your son and your son's son, all the days of your life—and that your days may be prolonged.
verses.6:3: Hear therefore, O Israel, and take care to perform them, that it may go well with you and that you may multiply exceedingly, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you—a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.6:4: Hear, O Israel: the LORD is our God; the LORD is one.
verses.6:5: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
verses.6:6: And these words which I command you this day shall be upon your heart.
verses.6:7: You shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall speak of them when you sit in your house, when you walk along the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.
verses.6:8: And you shall bind them as a sign upon your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.
verses.6:9: And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates.
verses.6:10: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD your God brings you into the land which He swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob—to give you, with great and fine cities which you did not build,
verses.6:11: and houses full of all good things which you did not fill, and hewn cisterns which you did not hew, vineyards and olive trees which you did not plant, and you eat and are satisfied,
verses.6:12: then take heed to yourself, lest you forget the LORD, who brought you forth from the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.6:13: You shall fear the LORD your God, and Him you shall serve, and by His name you shall swear.
verses.6:14: You shall not walk after other gods, the gods of the peoples who are all around you,
verses.6:15: for the LORD your God in your midst is a jealous God—lest the wrath of the LORD your God be kindled against you, and He destroy you from the face of the earth.
verses.6:16: You shall not test the LORD your God, as you tested Him at Massah.
verses.6:17: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and His testimonies and His statutes which He has commanded you.
verses.6:18: And you shall do what is right and good in the sight of the LORD, that it may go well with you, and that you may enter and possess the good land which the LORD swore to your fathers,
verses.6:19: by driving out all your enemies from before you, just as the LORD has spoken.
verses.6:20: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, "What are the testimonies, the statutes, and the judgments which the LORD our God has commanded you?"
verses.6:21: then you shall say to your son, "We were slaves to Pharaoh in Egypt, and the LORD brought us forth from Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.6:22: And the LORD displayed signs and wonders, great and grievous, against Egypt, against Pharaoh, and against all his household, before our eyes.
verses.6:23: And He brought us out from there, that He might bring us in, to give us the land which He swore to our fathers.
verses.6:24: And the LORD commanded us to perform all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that He might preserve us alive, as it is this day.
verses.6:25: And it shall be righteousness for us if we take care to perform all this commandment before the LORD our God, just as He has commanded us."
verses.7:1: When the LORD your God brings you into the land that you are entering to possess, and drives away many nations from before you—the Hittites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations more numerous and mightier than you,
verses.7:2: and when the LORD your God delivers them before you and you strike them down, you shall utterly devote them to destruction; you shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.
verses.7:3: And you shall not intermarry with them; you shall not give your daughter to their son, nor shall you take their daughter for your son.
verses.7:4: For they will turn your son away from following Me, and they will serve other gods; and the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and He will destroy you swiftly.
verses.7:5: Rather, thus you shall deal with them: you shall tear down their altars, shatter their sacred pillars, hew down their Asherah poles, and burn their carved images with fire.
verses.7:6: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God; the LORD your God has chosen you to be for Himself a people of treasured possession, above all the peoples who are upon the face of the earth.
verses.7:7: It was not because you were more numerous than all the peoples that the LORD set His affection upon you and chose you, for you were the fewest of all the peoples.
verses.7:8: Rather, because the LORD loved you and because He kept the oath that He swore to your fathers, the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.7:9: Therefore know that the LORD your God, He is God, the faithful God, who keeps the covenant and lovingkindness with those who love Him and keep His commandments to a thousand generations,
verses.7:10: and repays those who hate Him to their face, to destroy them; He will not delay with the one who hates Him, but to his face He will repay him.
verses.7:11: Therefore you shall keep the commandment, the statutes, and the judgments that I command you this day, to do them.
verses.7:12: And it shall come to pass, because you hearken to these judgments, and keep and do them, that the LORD your God will keep with you the covenant and the lovingkindness that He swore to your fathers.
verses.7:13: And He will love you, bless you, and multiply you; He will also bless the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your ground—your grain, your new wine, and your fresh oil, the increase of your herds and the young of your flock—upon the land that He swore to your fathers to give you.
verses.7:14: You shall be blessed above all peoples; there shall not be a barren male or female among you, nor among your livestock.
verses.7:15: And the LORD will remove from you every sickness; none of the evil diseases of Egypt that you have known will He lay upon you, but He will bring them upon all who hate you.
verses.7:16: And you shall consume all the peoples whom the LORD your God gives over to you; your eye shall have no pity on them, nor shall you serve their gods, for that would be a snare to you.
verses.7:17: If you say in your heart, "These nations are more numerous than I; how can I dispossess them?"
verses.7:18: you shall not fear them; you shall surely remember what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:
verses.7:19: the great trials that your eyes beheld, the signs and the wonders, the mighty hand and the outstretched arm, by which the LORD your God brought you out—so shall the LORD your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.
verses.7:20: Moreover, the LORD your God will send the hornet among them, until those who remain and those who hide themselves from before you have perished.
verses.7:21: You shall not be terrified before them, for the LORD your God is in your midst, a great and awesome God.
verses.7:22: And the LORD your God will drive away these nations from before you little by little; you will not be able to make an end of them swiftly, lest the beasts of the field multiply against you.
verses.7:23: But the LORD your God will deliver them before you, and will throw them into a great panic until they are destroyed.
verses.7:24: And He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall cause their name to perish from under heaven; no man shall stand before you until you have destroyed them.
verses.7:25: The carved images of their gods you shall burn with fire; you shall not covet the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be ensnared by it, for it is an abomination to the LORD your God.
verses.7:26: Nor shall you bring an abomination into your house, and become devoted to destruction like it; you shall utterly detest it and utterly abhor it, for it is a thing devoted to destruction.
verses.8:1: Every commandment that I command you this day you shall be careful to observe, that you may live and multiply, and enter and possess the land that the LORD swore to your fathers.
verses.8:2: And you shall remember all the way by which the LORD your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, to humble you and to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep His commandments or not.
verses.8:3: And He humbled you, caused you to hunger, and fed you with manna, which you did not know, nor did your fathers know, that He might make you know that man does not live by bread alone, but by everything that goes forth from the mouth of the LORD does man live.
verses.8:4: Your garment did not wear out upon you, nor did your foot swell, these forty years.
verses.8:5: Therefore you shall know in your heart that just as a man chastens his son, so the LORD your God chastens you.
verses.8:6: And you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in His ways and to fear Him.
verses.8:7: For the LORD your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and deep springs issuing forth in the valley and in the hill country;
verses.8:8: a land of wheat and barley, of vines, fig trees, and pomegranates, a land of olive oil and honey;
verses.8:9: a land where you shall eat bread without scarcity, where you shall lack nothing; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose mountains you may hew copper.
verses.8:10: And you shall eat and be satisfied, and you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land that He has given you.
verses.8:11: Take heed to yourself, lest you forget the LORD your God by failing to keep His commandments, His judgments, and His statutes that I command you this day,
verses.8:12: lest, when you have eaten and are satisfied, and have built fine houses and dwell in them,
verses.8:13: and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and gold increase for you, and all that belongs to you increases,
verses.8:14: then your heart be lifted up, and you forget the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;
verses.8:15: who led you through the great and dreadful wilderness, with fiery serpents and scorpions and thirsty ground where there was no water; who brought forth water for you out of the flinty rock;
verses.8:16: who fed you with manna in the wilderness, which your fathers did not know, to humble you and to test you, to do you good in your latter end;
verses.8:17: and you say in your heart, "My own strength and the might of my hand have acquired this wealth for me."
verses.8:18: Rather, you shall remember the LORD your God, for it is He who gives you strength to acquire wealth, that He may establish His covenant that He swore to your fathers, as it is this day.
verses.8:19: And it shall come to pass, if you indeed forget the LORD your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them and bow down to them, I solemnly testify against you this day that you shall surely perish.
verses.8:20: Like the nations that the LORD causes to perish before you, so shall you perish, because you would not hearken to the voice of the LORD your God.
verses.9:1: Hear, O Israel: you are crossing over the Jordan today to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself, cities great and fortified up to heaven,
verses.9:2: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard, "Who can stand before the sons of Anak?"
verses.9:3: Know therefore today that the LORD your God is He who crosses over before you as a consuming fire; He will destroy them and He will subdue them before you, and you shall drive them out and make them perish swiftly, just as the LORD has spoken to you.
verses.9:4: Do not say in your heart, when the LORD your God thrusts them out from before you, saying, "Because of my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land"—for it is on account of the wickedness of these nations that the LORD is dispossessing them from before you.
verses.9:5: It is not because of your righteousness or the uprightness of your heart that you are going in to possess their land, but because of the wickedness of these nations the LORD your God is driving them out from before you, and in order to confirm the word which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.9:6: Know therefore that it is not because of your righteousness that the LORD your God is giving you this good land to possess it, for you are a stiff-necked people.
verses.9:7: Remember, do not forget, how you provoked the LORD your God to wrath in the wilderness; from the day that you went out from the land of Egypt until your coming to this place, you have been rebellious against the LORD.
verses.9:8: Also at Horeb you provoked the LORD to wrath, and the LORD was so angry with you as to destroy you.
verses.9:9: When I went up the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant which the LORD made with you, I remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights; I ate no bread and drank no water.
verses.9:10: Then the LORD delivered to me the two tablets of stone written with the finger of God, and on them were all the words which the LORD spoke with you on the mountain from the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly.
verses.9:11: And it came to pass, at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the LORD gave me the two tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant.
verses.9:12: Then the LORD said to me, "Arise, go down quickly from here, for your people whom you brought out from Egypt have acted corruptly; they have turned aside quickly from the way which I commanded them; they have made for themselves a molten image."
verses.9:13: Moreover the LORD spoke to me, saying, "I have seen this people, and behold, it is a stiff-necked people.
verses.9:14: Let Me alone, that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven; and I will make of you a nation mightier and more numerous than they."
verses.9:15: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire; and the two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.
verses.9:16: And I looked, and behold, you had sinned against the LORD your God; you had made for yourselves a molten calf; you had turned aside quickly from the way which the LORD had commanded you.
verses.9:17: Then I took hold of the two tablets and cast them out of my two hands, and shattered them before your eyes.
verses.9:18: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights; I ate no bread and drank no water, because of all your sin which you had committed in doing what was evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke Him to anger.
verses.9:19: For I dreaded the anger and fury with which the LORD was wrathful against you, to destroy you. Yet the LORD listened to me at that time also.
verses.9:20: And with Aaron the LORD was exceedingly angry, to destroy him; so I prayed for Aaron also at that same time.
verses.9:21: Then I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire and crushed it, grinding it thoroughly until it was as fine as dust; and I cast its dust into the brook that ran down from the mountain.
verses.9:22: Also at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah, you provoked the LORD to wrath.
verses.9:23: Likewise, when the LORD sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, "Go up and possess the land which I have given you," then you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God, and you did not believe Him nor obey His voice.
verses.9:24: You have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.
verses.9:25: So I fell down before the LORD those forty days and forty nights that I lay prostrate, because the LORD had said He would destroy you.
verses.9:26: And I prayed to the LORD and said, "O Lord GOD, do not destroy Your people and Your inheritance, whom You have redeemed through Your greatness, whom You have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.9:27: Remember Your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; do not look on the stubbornness of this people, or on their wickedness, or on their sin,
verses.9:28: lest the land from which You brought us out say, 'Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which He promised them, and because He hated them, He has brought them out to put them to death in the wilderness.'
verses.9:29: Yet they are Your people and Your inheritance, whom You brought out by Your great power and by Your outstretched arm."
verses.10:1: At that time the LORD said to me, "Hew for yourself two tablets of stone like the first, and come up to Me on the mountain, and make for yourself an ark of wood.
verses.10:2: And I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke; and you shall place them in the ark."
verses.10:3: So I made an ark of acacia wood and hewed two tablets of stone like the first, and went up the mountain with the two tablets in my hand.
verses.10:4: And He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the Ten Commandments, which the LORD had spoken to you on the mountain from the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly; and the LORD gave them to me.
verses.10:5: Then I turned and came down from the mountain, and placed the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are, just as the LORD commanded me.
verses.10:6: Now the children of Israel journeyed from Beeroth-bene-jaakan to Moserah; there Aaron died, and there he was buried, and Eleazar his son ministered as priest in his place.
verses.10:7: From there they journeyed to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.
verses.10:8: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister to Him and to bless in His name, to this day.
verses.10:9: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD is his inheritance, just as the LORD your God spoke to him.
verses.10:10: And I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD listened to me at that time also; the LORD was not willing to destroy you.
verses.10:11: Then the LORD said to me, "Arise, set out on the journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them."
verses.10:12: And now, Israel, what does the LORD your God require of you, but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways and to love Him, to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.10:13: to keep the commandments of the LORD and His statutes which I command you today for your good?
verses.10:14: Behold, to the LORD your God belong the heavens and the heaven of heavens, the earth and all that is in it.
verses.10:15: Yet the LORD set His affection on your fathers alone to love them, and He chose their descendants after them, even you above all peoples, as it is this day.
verses.10:16: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and do not stiffen your neck any longer.
verses.10:17: For the LORD your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, mighty and awesome, who shows no partiality nor takes a bribe.
verses.10:18: He executes justice for the fatherless and the widow, and loves the sojourner, giving him bread and clothing.
verses.10:19: Therefore you shall love the sojourner, for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
verses.10:20: You shall fear the LORD your God; Him you shall serve, and to Him you shall hold fast, and by His name you shall swear.
verses.10:21: He is your praise, and He is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome deeds which your eyes have seen.
verses.10:22: With seventy souls your fathers went down to Egypt, and now the LORD your God has made you as the stars of heaven in multitude.
verses.11:1: And you shall love the LORD your God, and keep His charge, His statutes, His ordinances, and His commandments always.
verses.11:2: Know this day—for I am not speaking with your children, who have not known and who have not seen—the discipline of the LORD your God, His greatness, His mighty hand, and His outstretched arm,
verses.11:3: and His signs and His deeds which He did in the midst of Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to all his land;
verses.11:4: and what He did to the army of Egypt, to its horses and its chariots, how He caused the waters of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and the LORD destroyed them to this very day;
verses.11:5: and what He did for you in the wilderness until you came to this place;
verses.11:6: and what He did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab the son of Reuben—how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them, along with their households, their tents, and every living thing that followed at their feet, in the midst of all Israel.
verses.11:7: For your own eyes have seen all the great work of the LORD which He has done.
verses.11:8: Therefore you shall keep the whole commandment which I command you this day, that you may be strong, and go in and possess the land into which you are crossing over to possess it,
verses.11:9: and that you may prolong your days upon the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give to them and to their descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.11:10: For the land which you are entering to possess is not like the land of Egypt from which you came out, where you sowed your seed and watered it with your foot, like a garden of herbs;
verses.11:11: rather, the land into which you are crossing over to possess is a land of hills and valleys, drinking water from the rain of heaven,
verses.11:12: a land for which the LORD your God cares; the eyes of the LORD your God are continually upon it, from the beginning of the year to the very end of the year.
verses.11:13: And it shall come to pass, if you diligently obey My commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.11:14: then I will grant the rain for your land in its due season, the early rain and the latter rain, so that you may gather in your grain, your new wine, and your fresh oil.
verses.11:15: And I will give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you shall eat and be satisfied.
verses.11:16: Take heed to yourselves, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn aside and serve other gods and bow down to them,
verses.11:17: and the wrath of the LORD be kindled against you, and He shut up the heavens so that there is no rain, and the ground does not yield its produce, and you perish quickly from the good land which the LORD is giving you.
verses.11:18: You shall therefore place these words of mine upon your heart and upon your soul, and you shall bind them as a sign upon your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.
verses.11:19: And you shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house and when you walk along the way, when you lie down and when you rise up.
verses.11:20: And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates,
verses.11:21: that your days and the days of your children may be multiplied upon the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give them, like the days of the heavens above the earth.
verses.11:22: For if you carefully keep all this commandment which I command you to do, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways, and to hold fast to Him,
verses.11:23: then the LORD will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourselves.
verses.11:24: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the River Euphrates, even to the Western Sea, shall be your border.
verses.11:25: No man shall stand against you; the LORD your God will put the dread of you and the fear of you upon the face of all the land where you tread, just as He has spoken to you.
verses.11:26: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse:
verses.11:27: the blessing, if you obey the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you this day;
verses.11:28: and the curse, if you do not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside from the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods which you have not known.
verses.11:29: And it shall be, when the LORD your God has brought you into the land which you are entering to possess, that you shall set the blessing upon Mount Gerizim and the curse upon Mount Ebal.
verses.11:30: Are they not beyond the Jordan, beyond the road toward the setting of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah, opposite Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?
verses.11:31: For you are about to cross over the Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God is giving you, and you shall possess it and dwell in it.
verses.11:32: And you shall be careful to observe all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you this day.
verses.12:1: These are the statutes and the ordinances which you shall be careful to observe in the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess, all the days that you live upon the earth.
verses.12:2: You shall utterly destroy all the places where the nations whom you are dispossessing served their gods, upon the high mountains and upon the hills and under every green tree.
verses.12:3: And you shall tear down their altars, shatter their sacred pillars, and burn their Asherah poles with fire; you shall cut down the carved images of their gods and destroy their name from that place.
verses.12:4: You shall not do so toward the LORD your God.
verses.12:5: Rather, you shall seek the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put His name there for His dwelling, and there you shall come.
verses.12:6: There you shall bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the heave offering of your hand, your vowed offerings, your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herds and your flocks.
verses.12:7: And there you shall eat before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice in all to which you have put your hand, you and your households, in which the LORD your God has blessed you.
verses.12:8: You shall not do at all as we are doing here this day, every man doing whatever is right in his own eyes,
verses.12:9: for as yet you have not come to the rest and to the inheritance which the LORD your God is giving you.
verses.12:10: But when you cross over the Jordan and dwell in the land which the LORD your God is giving you to inherit, and He gives you rest from all your enemies round about, so that you dwell in safety,
verses.12:11: then to the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause His name to dwell there, there you shall bring all that I command you: your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the heave offering of your hand, and all your choicest vowed offerings which you vow to the LORD.
verses.12:12: And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God—you, your sons and your daughters, your male servants and your female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, since he has no portion nor inheritance with you.
verses.12:13: Take heed to yourself, lest you offer up your burnt offerings in every place that you see;
verses.12:14: rather, in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of your tribes, there you shall offer up your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.
verses.12:15: However, according to all the desire of your soul you may slaughter and eat meat, according to the blessing of the LORD your God which He has given you within all your gates; the unclean and the clean may eat it, as of the gazelle and the deer.
verses.12:16: Only you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it out upon the ground like water.
verses.12:17: You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain or of your new wine or of your oil, nor the firstborn of your herd or of your flock, nor any of your vowed offerings which you vow, nor your freewill offerings, nor the heave offering of your hand.
verses.12:18: Rather, you shall eat them before the LORD your God in the place which the LORD your God shall choose—you, your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates; and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God in all to which you put your hand.
verses.12:19: Take heed to yourself, lest you forsake the Levite all your days upon your land.
verses.12:20: When the LORD your God enlarges your border as He has spoken to you, and you say, "I will eat meat," because your soul longs to eat meat, you may eat meat according to all the desire of your soul.
verses.12:21: If the place which the LORD your God shall choose to put His name there is too far from you, then you may slaughter from your herd and from your flock which the LORD has given you, just as I have commanded you, and you may eat within your gates according to all the desire of your soul.
verses.12:22: Just as the gazelle and the deer are eaten, so you shall eat it; the unclean and the clean alike shall eat it.
verses.12:23: Only be steadfast not to eat the blood, for the blood is the life; and you shall not eat the life with the flesh.
verses.12:24: You shall not eat it; you shall pour it out upon the ground like water.
verses.12:25: You shall not eat it, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do what is right in the sight of the LORD.
verses.12:26: Only the holy things which belong to you, and your vowed offerings, you shall take and go to the place which the LORD shall choose.
verses.12:27: And you shall offer your burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD your God; and the blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD your God, and you shall eat the flesh.
verses.12:28: Observe and obey all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you and with your children after you forever, when you do what is good and right in the sight of the LORD your God.
verses.12:29: When the LORD your God cuts off from before you the nations whom you are going in to dispossess, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land,
verses.12:30: take heed to yourself, lest you be ensnared to follow them after they have been destroyed from before you, and lest you inquire after their gods, saying, "How did these nations serve their gods? I also will do likewise."
verses.12:31: You shall not do so toward the LORD your God; for every abomination to the LORD which He hates they have done to their gods, for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.
verses.13:1: Every word that I am commanding you, you shall take care to do it; you shall not add to it, nor diminish from it.
verses.13:2: If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises in your midst, and gives you a sign or a wonder,
verses.13:3: and the sign or the wonder of which he spoke to you comes to pass, saying, "Let us go after other gods"—which you have not known—"and let us serve them,"
verses.13:4: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet or to that dreamer of dreams; for the LORD your God is testing you, to know whether you love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.13:5: You shall walk after the LORD your God and fear Him, and keep His commandments and heed His voice; you shall serve Him and cleave to Him.
verses.13:6: And that prophet or that dreamer of dreams shall be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of bondage, to turn you astray from the way in which the LORD your God commanded you to walk. So you shall purge the evil from your midst.
verses.13:7: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, secretly entices you, saying, "Let us go and serve other gods," which neither you nor your fathers have known,
verses.13:8: of the gods of the peoples who are all around you, near to you or far off from you, from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth,
verses.13:9: you shall not consent to him nor listen to him, nor shall your eye pity him, nor shall you spare him nor conceal him;
verses.13:10: but you shall surely slay him; your hand shall be first against him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people.
verses.13:11: And you shall stone him with stones so that he dies, because he sought to turn you astray from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.13:12: Then all Israel shall hear and fear, and shall not again do such an evil thing as this in your midst.
verses.13:13: If you hear in one of your cities, which the LORD your God is giving you to dwell there, saying,
verses.13:14: "Worthless men have gone out from your midst and have led astray the inhabitants of their city, saying, 'Let us go and serve other gods,'" which you have not known,
verses.13:15: then you shall inquire, and search out, and ask diligently. And behold, if it is true and the matter is established, that this abomination has been committed in your midst,
verses.13:16: you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, devoting it to destruction, and all that is in it and its livestock, with the edge of the sword.
verses.13:17: And you shall gather all its spoil into the midst of its open square, and burn with fire the city and all its spoil wholly to the LORD your God; and it shall be a perpetual heap; it shall not be built again.
verses.13:18: And nothing of the things devoted to destruction shall cling to your hand, that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of His anger, and grant you mercy, and have compassion on you and multiply you, just as He swore to your fathers,
verses.13:19: when you heed the voice of the LORD your God, to keep all His commandments which I command you this day, to do what is right in the eyes of the LORD your God.
verses.14:1: You are children of the LORD your God; you shall not cut yourselves nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.
verses.14:2: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God, and the LORD has chosen you to be for Him a people of treasured possession, above all the peoples who are on the face of the earth.
verses.14:3: You shall not eat any abominable thing.
verses.14:4: These are the beasts which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,
verses.14:5: the hart, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the mountain sheep.
verses.14:6: And every beast that parts the hoof, having the hoof cloven into two, and chews the cud among the beasts, that you may eat.
verses.14:7: Nevertheless, of those that chew the cud or of those that have the cloven hoof, you shall not eat these: the camel, the hare, and the rock badger; for they chew the cud, yet do not part the hoof; they are unclean to you.
verses.14:8: And the swine, because it parts the hoof yet does not chew the cud, it is unclean to you. You shall not eat of their flesh, nor shall you touch their dead carcass.
verses.14:9: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales you may eat.
verses.14:10: And whatever does not have fins and scales you shall not eat; it is unclean to you.
verses.14:11: Every clean bird you may eat.
verses.14:12: But these are the ones of which you shall not eat: the eagle, the bearded vulture, and the osprey;
verses.14:13: the buzzard, the falcon, and the kite after its kind;
verses.14:14: and every raven after its kind;
verses.14:15: the ostrich, the nighthawk, the sea gull, and the hawk after its kind;
verses.14:16: the little owl, the great owl, and the white owl;
verses.14:17: the pelican, the carrion vulture, and the cormorant;
verses.14:18: the stork, the heron after its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.
verses.14:19: And every winged swarming thing is unclean to you; they shall not be eaten.
verses.14:20: Every clean winged creature you may eat.
verses.14:21: You shall not eat anything that dies of itself; you may give it to the sojourner who is within your gates, that he may eat it, or you may sell it to a foreigner; for you are a holy people to the LORD your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother's milk.
verses.14:22: You shall surely tithe all the yield of your seed, which the field brings forth year by year.
verses.14:23: And you shall eat before the LORD your God, in the place which He chooses to make His name dwell there, the tithe of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your herds and of your flocks, that you may learn to fear the LORD your God always.
verses.14:24: And if the journey is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it, because the place which the LORD your God chooses to set His name there is too far from you, when the LORD your God blesses you,
verses.14:25: then you shall exchange it for silver, and bind up the silver in your hand, and go to the place which the LORD your God chooses.
verses.14:26: And you shall spend the silver for whatever your soul desires: for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul asks of you; and you shall eat there before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household.
verses.14:27: And the Levite who is within your gates, you shall not forsake him, for he has no portion nor inheritance with you.
verses.14:28: At the end of every three years you shall bring out all the tithe of your produce in that year, and lay it up within your gates.
verses.14:29: And the Levite—because he has no portion nor inheritance with you—and the sojourner and the fatherless and the widow who are within your gates shall come and eat and be satisfied, that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.
verses.15:1: At the end of every seven years you shall grant a release.
verses.15:2: And this is the manner of the release: every creditor shall release what he has lent to his neighbor; he shall not exact it of his neighbor or of his brother, because a release to the LORD has been proclaimed.
verses.15:3: Of a foreigner you may exact it, but whatever of yours is with your brother, your hand shall release;
verses.15:4: however, there shall be no poor among you; for the LORD will surely bless you in the land which the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance to possess,
verses.15:5: only if you diligently heed the voice of the LORD your God, to take care to do all this commandment which I command you this day.
verses.15:6: For the LORD your God will bless you just as He promised you; and you shall lend to many nations, yet you shall not borrow; and you shall rule over many nations, yet they shall not rule over you.
verses.15:7: If there is among you a poor man, one of your brethren within any of your gates in your land which the LORD your God is giving you, you shall not harden your heart nor shut your hand from your poor brother;
verses.15:8: but you shall surely open your hand to him, and willingly lend him sufficient for his need, in whatever he lacks.
verses.15:9: Take heed to yourself, lest there be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, "The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand," and your eye be evil against your poor brother, and you give him nothing, and he cry out against you to the LORD, and it be sin in you.
verses.15:10: You shall surely give to him, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him; because for this very thing the LORD your God will bless you in all your works and in all to which you put your hand.
verses.15:11: For the poor will never cease from the midst of the land; therefore I command you, saying, "You shall surely open your hand wide to your brother, to your afflicted, and to your needy in your land."
verses.15:12: If your brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall send him out free from you.
verses.15:13: And when you send him out free from you, you shall not send him away empty-handed;
verses.15:14: you shall furnish him liberally from your flock, and from your threshing floor, and from your winepress; from that with which the LORD your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.
verses.15:15: And you shall remember that you were a bondservant in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you; therefore I command you this thing today.
verses.15:16: And it shall be, if he says to you, "I will not go out from you," because he loves you and your household, since it is well with him with you,
verses.15:17: then you shall take the awl and thrust it through his ear into the door, and he shall be your bondservant forever. And to your maidservant also you shall do likewise.
verses.15:18: It shall not seem hard in your eyes when you send him out free from you; for he has served you six years, worth double the wages of a hired servant; and the LORD your God will bless you in all that you do.
verses.15:19: Every firstborn male that is born among your herd and among your flock you shall consecrate to the LORD your God; you shall do no work with the firstborn of your ox, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.
verses.15:20: You shall eat it before the LORD your God year by year in the place which the LORD chooses, you and your household.
verses.15:21: And if there is a blemish in it, if it is lame or blind, or has any serious blemish, you shall not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.
verses.15:22: You shall eat it within your gates; the unclean and the clean alike may eat it, as the gazelle and as the hart.
verses.15:23: Only you shall not eat its blood; you shall pour it out on the ground like water.
verses.16:1: Keep the month of Abib, and celebrate the Passover to the LORD your God, because in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you forth out of Egypt by night.
verses.16:2: And you shall sacrifice the Passover offering to the LORD your God, of the flock and of the herd, at the place that the LORD shall choose to cause His name to dwell there.
verses.16:3: You shall eat no leavened bread with it; seven days you shall eat unleavened bread with it, the bread of affliction—for you departed from the land of Egypt in haste—so that you may remember the day of your departure from the land of Egypt all the days of your life.
verses.16:4: And no leaven shall be seen with you throughout all your borders for seven days, nor shall any of the flesh that you sacrifice in the evening on the first day remain overnight until morning.
verses.16:5: You may not sacrifice the Passover inside any of your gates that the LORD your God is giving you.
verses.16:6: Rather, at the place that the LORD your God shall choose to cause His name to dwell, there you shall sacrifice the Passover in the evening, at the going down of the sun, at the appointed time of your departure from Egypt.
verses.16:7: And you shall cook and eat it in the place that the LORD your God shall choose; and in the morning you shall turn and go to your tents.
verses.16:8: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD your God; you shall do no work.
verses.16:9: Seven weeks you shall count for yourself; from the time the sickle first begins in the standing grain, you shall begin to count seven weeks.
verses.16:10: Then you shall keep the Feast of Weeks to the LORD your God with the measure of a freewill offering from your hand, which you shall give according as the LORD your God blesses you.
verses.16:11: And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God—you and your son and your daughter, your manservant and your maidservant, the Levite who is within your gates, and the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow who are in your midst—at the place that the LORD your God shall choose to cause His name to dwell there.
verses.16:12: And you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and you shall take care to perform these statutes.
verses.16:13: You shall celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles for yourself seven days, when you gather in from your threshing floor and from your winepress.
verses.16:14: And you shall rejoice in your feast: you and your son and your daughter, your manservant and your maidservant, and the Levite, the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates.
verses.16:15: Seven days you shall keep a feast to the LORD your God at the place that the LORD shall choose; because the LORD your God shall bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, so that you shall be altogether joyful.
verses.16:16: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the LORD your God in the place that He shall choose: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, at the Feast of Weeks, and at the Feast of Tabernacles; and none shall appear before the LORD empty-handed.
verses.16:17: Every man shall give according to the gift of his hand, according to the blessing of the LORD your God which He has bestowed upon you.
verses.16:18: Judges and officers you shall appoint for yourself in all your gates that the LORD your God is giving you, according to your tribes, and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.
verses.16:19: You shall not pervert justice; you shall not show partiality, nor shall you take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and subverts the words of the righteous.
verses.16:20: Justice, justice you shall pursue, so that you may live and possess the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
verses.16:21: You shall not plant for yourself an Asherah, any tree, beside the altar of the LORD your God that you shall make for yourself.
verses.16:22: Nor shall you set up for yourself a sacred pillar, which the LORD your God hates.
verses.17:1: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep in which there is a blemish, or any grave defect, for that is an abomination to the LORD your God.
verses.17:2: If there is found in your midst, within any of your gates that the LORD your God is giving you, a man or a woman who does what is evil in the sight of the LORD your God, in transgressing His covenant,
verses.17:3: and has gone and served other gods and bowed down to them, whether the sun or the moon or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded,
verses.17:4: and it is told to you and you hear of it, then you shall inquire diligently; and behold, if it is true and the matter is established that this abomination has been committed in Israel,
verses.17:5: then you shall bring forth that man or that woman who has done this wicked thing to your gates—even that man or that woman—and you shall stone them with stones until they die.
verses.17:6: By the mouth of two witnesses or three witnesses shall he who is worthy of death be put to death; he shall not be put to death by the mouth of one witness.
verses.17:7: The hand of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people; so you shall purge the evil from your midst.
verses.17:8: If a matter arises that is too difficult for you in judgment, between one kind of bloodshed and another, between one legal claim and another, or between one kind of assault and another—matters of controversy within your gates—then you shall arise and go up to the place that the LORD your God shall choose.
verses.17:9: And you shall come to the Levitical priests and to the judge who shall be in those days, and inquire of them; and they shall declare to you the sentence of judgment.
verses.17:10: And you shall act according to the word that they declare to you from that place which the LORD shall choose, and you shall take care to do according to all that they instruct you.
verses.17:11: According to the law that they teach you, and according to the judgment that they speak to you, you shall do; you shall not turn aside from the word that they declare to you, to the right hand or to the left.
verses.17:12: Now the man who acts presumptuously, so as not to heed the priest who stands there to minister to the LORD your God, or the judge—that man shall die; and you shall purge the evil from Israel.
