verses.17:13: And all the people shall hear and fear, and shall act presumptuously no more.
verses.17:14: When you come into the land that the LORD your God is giving you, and possess it and dwell in it, and say, "I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me,"
verses.17:15: you shall surely set over yourself a king whom the LORD your God shall choose; from among your brethren you shall set a king over yourself. You may not place a foreigner over yourself, one who is not your brother.
verses.17:16: Only he shall not multiply horses for himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt in order to multiply horses; for the LORD has said to you, "You shall not return by this way again."
verses.17:17: Neither shall he multiply wives for himself, lest his heart turn away; nor shall he greatly multiply silver and gold for himself.
verses.17:18: And it shall be, when he sits upon the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write for himself a copy of this law in a book, from that which is before the Levitical priests.
verses.17:19: And it shall remain with him, and he shall read in it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to perform them,
verses.17:20: that his heart may not be lifted up above his brethren, and that he may not turn aside from the commandment to the right hand or to the left, so that he may prolong his days over his kingdom, he and his sons, in the midst of Israel.
verses.18:1: The Levitical priests—all the tribe of Levi—shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel; they shall eat the offerings made by fire to the LORD, and His inheritance.
verses.18:2: They shall have no inheritance in the midst of their brethren; the LORD is their inheritance, as He spoke to them.
verses.18:3: Now this shall be the priests' due from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether an ox or a sheep: one shall give to the priest the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the stomach.
verses.18:4: The firstfruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your fresh oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep, you shall give to him.
verses.18:5: For from among all your tribes the LORD your God has chosen him to stand and minister in the name of the LORD, both he and his sons forever.
verses.18:6: And if a Levite comes from any of your gates out of all Israel where he sojourns, and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place that the LORD shall choose,
verses.18:7: then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, like all his brethren the Levites who stand there before the LORD.
verses.18:8: They shall eat equal portions, apart from what he receives from the sale of his ancestral property.
verses.18:9: When you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you, you shall not learn to follow the abominations of those nations.
verses.18:10: There shall not be found among you anyone who makes his son or his daughter pass through the fire, or one who practices divination, or a soothsayer, or one who interprets omens, or a sorcerer,
verses.18:11: or one who casts spells, or one who consults a medium or a spiritist, or one who inquires of the dead.
verses.18:12: For whoever does these things is an abomination to the LORD, and on account of these abominations the LORD your God is driving them out from before you.
verses.18:13: You shall be blameless with the LORD your God.
verses.18:14: For these nations, which you are about to dispossess, listen to soothsayers and diviners; but as for you, the LORD your God has not permitted you to do so.
verses.18:15: A prophet from your midst, from among your brethren, like me, the LORD your God shall raise up for you; to him you shall listen,
verses.18:16: according to all that you asked of the LORD your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, saying, "May I not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, nor see this great fire any more, lest I die."
verses.18:17: And the LORD said to me, "They have done well in what they have spoken.
verses.18:18: I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their brethren, and I will put My words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them everything that I command him.
verses.18:19: And it shall come to pass that whoever will not heed My words, which he shall speak in My name, I Myself will require it of him.
verses.18:20: Yet the prophet who presumes to speak a word in My name that I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods—that prophet shall die."
verses.18:21: And if you say in your heart, "How may we know the word that the LORD has not spoken?"
verses.18:22: When a prophet speaks in the name of the LORD, if the thing does not happen nor come to pass, that is the word which the LORD has not spoken; the prophet has spoken it presumptuously—you shall not stand in dread of him.
verses.19:1: When the LORD your God cuts off the nations whose land the LORD your God is giving you, and you dispossess them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,
verses.19:2: you shall set apart three cities for yourself in the midst of your land, which the LORD your God is giving you to possess.
verses.19:3: You shall prepare the way for yourself, and divide into three parts the territory of your land which the LORD your God causes you to inherit, that every manslayer may flee there.
verses.19:4: And this is the case of the manslayer who flees there and lives: whoever strikes his neighbor unintentionally, and did not hate him in time past—
verses.19:5: as when a man goes with his neighbor into the forest to hew wood, and his hand swings the ax to cut down the tree, and the iron slips off the wooden handle and strikes his neighbor so that he dies—he shall flee to one of these cities and live,
verses.19:6: lest the avenger of blood pursue the manslayer while his heart is hot, and overtake him because the way is long, and strike him mortally, though he was not deserving of death, because he did not hate him in time past.
verses.19:7: Therefore I command you, saying, "You shall set apart three cities for yourself."
verses.19:8: And if the LORD your God enlarges your territory, as He swore to your fathers, and gives you all the land that He promised to give to your fathers—
verses.19:9: provided you keep all this commandment to do it, which I command you today, to love the LORD your God and to walk in His ways always—then you shall add three more cities for yourself besides these three,
verses.19:10: so that innocent blood may not be shed in the midst of your land, which the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and thus bloodguilt be upon you.
verses.19:11: But if a man hates his neighbor, and lies in wait for him, and rises against him and strikes him mortally so that he dies, and flees to one of these cities,
verses.19:12: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him from there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.
verses.19:13: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall purge the blood of the innocent from Israel, that it may be well with you.
verses.19:14: You shall not move your neighbor's landmark, which those of old have set, in your inheritance that you will inherit in the land which the LORD your God is giving you to possess.
verses.19:15: One witness shall not rise up against a man concerning any iniquity or any sin, in any offense that he commits; by the mouth of two witnesses or by the mouth of three witnesses the matter shall be established.
verses.19:16: If a malicious witness rises up against a man to testify against him of wrongdoing,
verses.19:17: then both men who have the dispute shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges who serve in those days.
verses.19:18: And the judges shall inquire diligently, and behold, if the witness is a false witness and has testified falsely against his brother,
verses.19:19: then you shall do to him just as he had planned to do to his brother; so you shall purge the evil from your midst.
verses.19:20: And those who remain shall hear and fear, and shall never again commit such an evil deed in your midst.
verses.19:21: Your eye shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
verses.20:1: When you go out to battle against your enemies and see horses and chariots, a people more numerous than you, you shall not be afraid of them; for the LORD your God is with you, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.20:2: And it shall be, when you draw near to the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak to the people,
verses.20:3: and he shall say to them, "Hear, O Israel: You are drawing near today to battle against your enemies. Do not let your heart grow faint; do not be afraid, and do not tremble or be terrified because of them;
verses.20:4: for the LORD your God is the One who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you."
verses.20:5: Then the officers shall speak to the people, saying, "What man is there who has built a new house and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man dedicate it.
verses.20:6: And what man is there who has planted a vineyard and has not enjoyed its fruit? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man enjoy its fruit.
verses.20:7: And what man is there who has betrothed a wife and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man take her."
verses.20:8: Then the officers shall speak further to the people, and say, "What man is there who is fearful and fainthearted? Let him go and return to his house, lest he cause the heart of his brethren to melt like his own heart."
verses.20:9: And it shall be, when the officers have finished speaking to the people, that they shall appoint commanders of the armies at the head of the people.
verses.20:10: When you draw near to a city to fight against it, you shall proclaim terms of peace to it.
verses.20:11: And it shall be, if it answers you with peace and opens to you, then all the people who are found in it shall become forced laborers for you and shall serve you.
verses.20:12: But if it will not make peace with you, and makes war against you, then you shall besiege it.
verses.20:13: And when the LORD your God delivers it into your hand, you shall strike every male in it with the edge of the sword.
verses.20:14: Only the women, the little ones, the livestock, and all that is in the city—all its spoil—you shall take as plunder for yourself; and you shall eat the spoil of your enemies, which the LORD your God has given you.
verses.20:15: Thus you shall do to all the cities that are very far from you, which are not of the cities of these nations.
verses.20:16: However, from the cities of these peoples which the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, you shall not leave alive anything that breathes;
verses.20:17: rather, you shall utterly devote them to destruction—the Hittite and the Amorite, the Canaanite and the Perizzite, the Hivite and the Jebusite—just as the LORD your God has commanded you,
verses.20:18: lest they teach you to do according to all their abominations which they have done for their gods, and you sin against the LORD your God.
verses.20:19: When you besiege a city for many days, making war against it to capture it, you shall not destroy its trees by wielding an ax against them; for you may eat from them, and you shall not cut them down. For is the tree of the field a man, that it should come under siege before you?
verses.20:20: Only the trees that you know are not trees for food may you destroy and cut down, that you may build siegeworks against the city that makes war with you, until it falls.
verses.21:1: If anyone is found slain in the land which the LORD your God is giving you to possess, lying in the open field, and it is not known who struck him,
verses.21:2: then your elders and your judges shall go out and measure the distance to the cities that are around the slain man.
verses.21:3: And it shall be that the elders of the city nearest to the slain man shall take a heifer from the herd which has not been worked and which has not pulled in a yoke.
verses.21:4: And the elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with a perennial stream, which has neither been plowed nor sown, and they shall break the heifer's neck there in the valley.
verses.21:5: Then the priests, the sons of Levi, shall come near; for the LORD your God has chosen them to minister to Him and to bless in the name of the LORD, and by their word every dispute and every assault shall be settled.
verses.21:6: And all the elders of that city nearest to the slain man shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley.
verses.21:7: And they shall answer and say, "Our hands have not shed this blood, nor have our eyes seen it.
verses.21:8: Make atonement, O LORD, for Your people Israel, whom You have redeemed, and do not lay the guilt of innocent blood in the midst of Your people Israel." And atonement shall be made for them concerning the blood.
verses.21:9: So you shall purge the guilt of innocent blood from your midst, when you do what is right in the sight of the LORD.
verses.21:10: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and the LORD your God delivers them into your hand, and you take captives from them,
verses.21:11: and you see among the captives a woman of beautiful form, and you desire her and would take her for yourself as a wife,
verses.21:12: then you shall bring her into your house, and she shall shave her head and trim her nails.
verses.21:13: She shall also put off the garment of her captivity from her, and remain in your house, and mourn her father and her mother a full month; and after that you may go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.
verses.21:14: And it shall be, if you have no delight in her, that you shall let her go wherever she wishes; you shall certainly not sell her for silver, nor treat her harshly as a slave, because you have humbled her.
verses.21:15: If a man has two wives, one loved and the other unloved, and they have borne him sons, both the loved and the unloved, and if the firstborn son belongs to her who is unloved,
verses.21:16: then it shall be, on the day he bequeaths his possessions to his sons, that he may not treat the son of the loved wife as firstborn in preference to the son of the unloved, who is truly the firstborn.
verses.21:17: Rather, he shall acknowledge the son of the unloved wife as the firstborn by giving him a double portion of all that he possesses; for he is the firstfruits of his strength; the right of the firstborn belongs to him.
verses.21:18: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and though they discipline him, he will not listen to them,
verses.21:19: then his father and his mother shall lay hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city, to the gate of his place.
verses.21:20: And they shall say to the elders of his city, "This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious; he will not obey our voice; he is a glutton and a drunkard."
verses.21:21: Then all the men of his city shall stone him with stones so that he dies; thus you shall purge the evil from your midst, and all Israel shall hear and fear.
verses.21:22: And if a man has committed a sin worthy of the sentence of death, and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,
verses.21:23: his body shall not remain overnight upon the tree, but you shall surely bury him on that same day, for one who is hanged is accursed of God; thus you shall not defile your land which the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.
verses.22:1: You shall not see your brother's ox or his sheep straying and hide yourself from them; you shall surely return them to your brother.
verses.22:2: And if your brother is not near to you, or if you do not know him, then you shall gather it into your house, and it shall remain with you until your brother seeks after it; then you shall restore it to him.
verses.22:3: In like manner you shall do with his donkey, and so you shall do with his garment, and so you shall do with every lost thing of your brother's that is lost from him and you have found; you may not hide yourself.
verses.22:4: You shall not see your brother's donkey or his ox fallen down along the way and hide yourself from them; you shall surely lift them up with him.
verses.22:5: A man's apparel shall not be upon a woman, nor shall a man wear a woman's garment, for everyone who does these things is an abomination to the LORD your God.
verses.22:6: If a bird's nest happens to lie before you along the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young birds or eggs, and the mother is sitting upon the young birds or upon the eggs, you shall not take the mother with the young.
verses.22:7: You shall surely send the mother away, and the young you may take for yourself, so that it may go well with you and you may prolong your days.
verses.22:8: When you build a new house, you shall make a parapet for your roof, so that you do not bring bloodguilt upon your house if anyone falls from it.
verses.22:9: You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, lest the entire yield become forfeited—the seed that you sow and the produce of the vineyard.
verses.22:10: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.
verses.22:11: You shall not wear a mingled fabric, wool and linen together.
verses.22:12: You shall make tassels for yourself on the four corners of the garment with which you cover yourself.
verses.22:13: If a man takes a wife, and goes in to her, and hates her,
verses.22:14: and lays shameful charges against her, and brings out an evil reputation against her, saying, "I took this woman, and when I drew near to her I found no tokens of virginity in her,"
verses.22:15: then the father and the mother of the young woman shall take and bring forth the tokens of the young woman's virginity to the elders of the city at the gate.
verses.22:16: And the father of the young woman shall say to the elders, "I gave my daughter to this man as a wife, and he hates her.
verses.22:17: And behold, he has laid shameful charges, saying, 'I found no tokens of virginity in your daughter.' Yet these are the tokens of my daughter's virginity." Then they shall spread out the garment before the elders of the city.
verses.22:18: Then the elders of that city shall take the man and chastise him.
verses.22:19: And they shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver and give them to the father of the young woman, because he has brought an evil reputation upon a virgin of Israel. She shall remain his wife; he may not send her away all his days.
verses.22:20: But if this matter is true, and tokens of virginity were not found for the young woman,
verses.22:21: then they shall bring out the young woman to the entrance of her father's house, and the men of her city shall stone her with stones until she dies, because she has committed a disgraceful folly in Israel by playing the harlot in her father's house. Thus you shall purge the evil from your midst.
verses.22:22: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then both of them shall die—the man who lay with the woman, and the woman also. Thus you shall purge the evil from Israel.
verses.22:23: If there is a young woman, a virgin betrothed to a man, and a man finds her in the city and lies with her,
verses.22:24: then you shall bring both of them out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them with stones until they die—the young woman because she did not cry out in the city, and the man because he violated his neighbor's wife. Thus you shall purge the evil from your midst.
verses.22:25: But if in the field the man finds the betrothed young woman, and the man seizes her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die.
verses.22:26: To the young woman you shall do nothing; there is in the young woman no sin worthy of death, for just as when a man rises up against his neighbor and murders him, so is this case.
verses.22:27: For he found her in the field; the betrothed young woman cried out, yet there was no one to rescue her.
verses.22:28: If a man finds a young woman, a virgin who is not betrothed, and takes hold of her and lies with her, and they are found out,
verses.22:29: then the man who lay with her shall give to the father of the young woman fifty shekels of silver, and she shall become his wife because he has violated her; he may not send her away all his days.
verses.23:1: A man shall not take his father's wife, nor shall he uncover his father's skirt.
verses.23:2: One who is wounded by crushing or whose private member is cut off shall not enter the assembly of the LORD.
verses.23:3: One born of an unlawful union shall not enter the assembly of the LORD; even to the tenth generation, none of his descendants shall enter the assembly of the LORD.
verses.23:4: No Ammonite or Moabite shall enter the assembly of the LORD; even to the tenth generation, none belonging to them shall enter the assembly of the LORD forever,
verses.23:5: because they did not meet you with bread and water along the way when you came forth from Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia to curse you.
verses.23:6: Yet the LORD your God would not listen to Balaam, but the LORD your God turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the LORD your God loved you.
verses.23:7: You shall not seek their peace or their welfare all your days forever.
verses.23:8: You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother; you shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you were a sojourner in his land.
verses.23:9: The children who are born to them in the third generation may enter the assembly of the LORD.
verses.23:10: When you go forth in encampment against your enemies, then you shall keep yourself from every evil thing.
verses.23:11: If there is among you any man who is not clean because of an occurrence by night, then he shall go outside the camp; he shall not come within the camp.
verses.23:12: And it shall be, as evening approaches, he shall wash himself with water; and when the sun sets, he may come into the midst of the camp.
verses.23:13: Also you shall have an appointed place outside the camp, and you shall go out there.
verses.23:14: And you shall have a trowel among your gear; and it shall be, when you sit down outside, that you shall dig with it and turn back and cover your excrement.
verses.23:15: For the LORD your God walks in the midst of your camp to deliver you and to give your enemies over before you; therefore your camp shall be holy, lest He see any indecent thing among you and turn away from you.
verses.23:16: You shall not surrender to his master a servant who has escaped to you from his master.
verses.23:17: He shall dwell with you in your midst, in the place that he chooses within any of your gates, wherever it is good for him; you shall not oppress him.
verses.23:18: There shall be no cult prostitute among the daughters of Israel, nor shall there be a male cult prostitute among the sons of Israel.
verses.23:19: You shall not bring the wages of a harlot or the price of a dog into the house of the LORD your God for any vow, for both of these are an abomination to the LORD your God.
verses.23:20: You shall not charge interest to your brother—interest on money, interest on food, or interest on anything that is lent at interest.
verses.23:21: To a foreigner you may charge interest, but to your brother you shall not charge interest, so that the LORD your God may bless you in every undertaking of your hand in the land that you are entering to possess.
verses.23:22: When you make a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not delay to fulfill it; for the LORD your God will surely require it of you, and it would be sin in you.
verses.23:23: But if you refrain from making a vow, there shall be no sin in you.
verses.23:24: What has gone forth from your lips you shall keep and perform, just as you have vowed as a freewill offering to the LORD your God, which you have spoken with your mouth.
verses.23:25: When you enter your neighbor's standing grain, you may pluck the heads of grain with your hand, but you shall not swing a sickle upon your neighbor's standing grain.
verses.23:26: When you enter your neighbor's vineyard, you may eat grapes according to your desire to your fill, but you shall not put any into your vessel.
verses.24:1: When a man takes a wife and marries her, and it comes to pass that she does not find favor in his eyes because he has found some unseemly thing in her, and he writes her a certificate of divorce, places it in her hand, and sends her away from his house,
verses.24:2: and she goes out from his house and departs and becomes the wife of another man,
verses.24:3: and the latter husband hates her, and writes her a certificate of divorce, places it in her hand, and sends her away from his house, or if the latter husband who took her as his wife dies,
verses.24:4: then her former husband who sent her away may not take her again to be his wife after she has been defiled, for that is an abomination before the LORD; and you shall not cause the land to sin, which the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.
verses.24:5: When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out with the army, nor shall any duty be imposed upon him; he shall be free for his house for one year, and shall bring joy to his wife whom he has taken.
verses.24:6: No man shall take a millstone or an upper millstone in pledge, for he takes a life in pledge.
verses.24:7: If a man is found stealing one of his brethren from among the children of Israel, and treats him harshly and sells him, then that thief shall die; thus you shall purge the evil from your midst.
verses.24:8: Take heed concerning a plague of leprosy, to observe diligently and to do according to all that the priests, the Levites, shall instruct you; as I commanded them, so you shall take care to do.
verses.24:9: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam on the way when you came out of Egypt.
verses.24:10: When you make a loan of anything to your neighbor, you shall not enter his house to take his pledge.
verses.24:11: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you are making the loan shall bring the pledge out to you.
verses.24:12: And if the man is poor, you shall not lie down to sleep with his pledge.
verses.24:13: You shall surely return the pledge to him as the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his own garment and bless you; and it shall be righteousness to you before the LORD your God.
verses.24:14: You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether one of your brethren or one of your sojourners who are in your land within your gates.
verses.24:15: On his day you shall give him his wages, and the sun shall not go down upon it, for he is poor and sets his heart upon it; lest he cry out against you to the LORD, and it be sin in you.
verses.24:16: Fathers shall not be put to death for children, nor shall children be put to death for fathers; every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
verses.24:17: You shall not pervert the justice due to the sojourner or the fatherless, nor take a widow's garment in pledge.
verses.24:18: But you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you from there; therefore I am commanding you to do this thing.
verses.24:19: When you reap your harvest in your field and forget a sheaf in the field, you shall not go back to get it; it shall be for the sojourner, for the fatherless, and for the widow, that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
verses.24:20: When you beat your olive trees, you shall not search the boughs again; it shall be for the sojourner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
verses.24:21: When you gather the grapes of your vineyard, you shall not glean it afterward; it shall be for the sojourner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
verses.24:22: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt; therefore I am commanding you to do this thing.
verses.25:1: If there is a dispute between men, and they approach the court and the judges judge them, then they shall justify the righteous and condemn the wicked.
verses.25:2: Then it shall be, if the wicked man deserves to be beaten, that the judge shall have him lie down and be beaten in his presence with a fixed number of stripes, according to his wickedness.
verses.25:3: Forty stripes he may give him, and no more; lest he exceed these and beat him with many more stripes, and your brother be degraded in your sight.
verses.25:4: You shall not muzzle an ox while it is threshing.
verses.25:5: If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the dead man shall not be married outside the family to a stranger; her husband's brother shall go in to her, take her as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband's brother to her.
verses.25:6: And it shall be that the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed to the name of his dead brother, that his name may not be blotted out from Israel.
verses.25:7: But if the man does not desire to take his brother's wife, then his brother's wife shall go up to the gate to the elders and say, "My husband's brother refuses to raise up a name for his brother in Israel; he is not willing to perform the duty of a husband's brother to me."
verses.25:8: Then the elders of his city shall summon him and speak to him. If he stands firm and says, "I do not desire to take her,"
verses.25:9: then his brother's wife shall approach him in the sight of the elders, remove his sandal from his foot, spit in his face, and answer and say, "So shall it be done to the man who will not build up his brother's house."
verses.25:10: And his name shall be called in Israel, "The house of him whose sandal was removed."
verses.25:11: When men strive together, a man and his brother, and the wife of the one draws near to rescue her husband from the hand of the one striking him, and she puts forth her hand and seizes him by his private parts,
verses.25:12: then you shall cut off her hand; your eye shall not show pity.
verses.25:13: You shall not have in your bag differing weights, a large and a small.
verses.25:14: You shall not have in your house differing measures, a large and a small.
verses.25:15: You shall have a full and just weight; you shall have a full and just measure, that your days may be prolonged in the land which the LORD your God is giving you.
verses.25:16: For all who do such things, all who act unrighteously, are an abomination to the LORD your God.
verses.25:17: Remember what Amalek did to you on the way as you came out of Egypt,
verses.25:18: how he met you on the way and attacked your rear, all the stragglers behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he did not fear God.
verses.25:19: Therefore it shall be, when the LORD your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around, in the land which the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance to possess, that you shall blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven. You shall not forget.
verses.26:1: And it shall be, when you have come into the land which the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and you possess it and dwell in it,
verses.26:2: that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall bring in from your land that the LORD your God is giving you, and put it in a basket, and go to the place which the LORD your God chooses to make His name dwell there.
verses.26:3: And you shall go to the priest who is in office in those days and say to him, "I declare today to the LORD your God that I have come to the land which the LORD swore to our fathers to give us."
verses.26:4: Then the priest shall take the basket from your hand and set it down before the altar of the LORD your God.
verses.26:5: And you shall answer and say before the LORD your God, "A wandering Aramean was my father; and he went down to Egypt and sojourned there, few in number, and there he became a nation, great, mighty, and populous.
verses.26:6: But the Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and laid hard bondage upon us.
verses.26:7: Then we cried out to the LORD, the God of our fathers, and the LORD heard our voice and looked upon our affliction and our labor and our oppression.
verses.26:8: And the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and with an outstretched arm, with great terror and with signs and wonders.
verses.26:9: He has brought us to this place and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.26:10: And now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground which You, O LORD, have given me." Then you shall set it before the LORD your God, and worship before the LORD your God.
verses.26:11: And you shall rejoice in every good thing which the LORD your God has given to you and to your house, you and the Levite and the sojourner who is in your midst.
verses.26:12: When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, the year of tithing, and have given it to the Levite, to the sojourner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, that they may eat within your gates and be satisfied,
verses.26:13: then you shall say before the LORD your God, "I have removed the sacred portion from the house, and also have given it to the Levite and to the sojourner, to the fatherless and to the widow, according to all Your commandment which You have commanded me; I have not transgressed Your commandments, nor have I forgotten them.
verses.26:14: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, nor have I removed any of it while unclean, nor have I given any of it for the dead; I have obeyed the voice of the LORD my God, and have done according to all that You have commanded me.
verses.26:15: Look down from Your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless Your people Israel and the ground which You have given us, just as You swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey."
verses.26:16: This day the LORD your God commands you to perform these statutes and judgments; therefore you shall keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.26:17: Today you have declared the LORD to be your God, and that you will walk in His ways and keep His statutes, His commandments, and His judgments, and that you will heed His voice.
verses.26:18: And today the LORD has declared you to be His treasured people, just as He promised you, and that you shall keep all His commandments,
verses.26:19: and that He will set you high above all the nations which He has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to the LORD your God, just as He has spoken.
verses.27:1: Then Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, "Observe the whole commandment that I am commanding you today.
verses.27:2: And it shall be, on the day when you cross over the Jordan into the land which the LORD your God is giving you, that you shall set up for yourself large stones and coat them with plaster.
verses.27:3: You shall write upon them all the words of this law when you have crossed over, so that you may enter into the land which the LORD your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has spoken to you.
verses.27:4: And it shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I am commanding you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.
verses.27:5: And there you shall build an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones; you shall not wield iron upon them.
verses.27:6: With whole stones you shall build the altar of the LORD your God, and upon it you shall offer up burnt offerings to the LORD your God.
verses.27:7: And you shall sacrifice peace offerings, and eat there, and rejoice before the LORD your God.
verses.27:8: And you shall write upon the stones all the words of this law very clearly."
verses.27:9: Then Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, "Keep silence and hear, O Israel: this very day you have become a people for the LORD your God.
verses.27:10: You shall therefore heed the voice of the LORD your God, and perform His commandments and His statutes which I am commanding you today."
verses.27:11: And Moses charged the people on that day, saying,
verses.27:12: "These shall stand to bless the people on Mount Gerizim when you cross over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
verses.27:13: And these shall stand for the curse on Mount Ebal: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
verses.27:14: Then the Levites shall declare and say to every man of Israel with a loud voice:
verses.27:15: 'Cursed is the man who makes a carved or molten image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of a craftsman, and sets it up in secret.' And all the people shall answer and say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:16: 'Cursed is the one who dishonors his father or his mother.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:17: 'Cursed is the one who shifts the landmark of his neighbor.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:18: 'Cursed is the one who misleads a blind man along the way.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:19: 'Cursed is the one who perverts the justice of the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:20: 'Cursed is the one who lies with the wife of his father, for he has uncovered the covering of his father.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:21: 'Cursed is the one who lies with any beast.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:22: 'Cursed is the one who lies with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:23: 'Cursed is the one who lies with his mother-in-law.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:24: 'Cursed is the one who strikes down his neighbor in secret.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:25: 'Cursed is the one who accepts a bribe to strike down a life of innocent blood.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:26: 'Cursed is the one who does not uphold the words of this law to perform them.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'"
verses.28:1: And it shall come to pass, if you faithfully heed the voice of the LORD your God, to keep and to do all His commandments that I command you this day, that the LORD your God will set you supreme above all the nations of the earth.
verses.28:2: And all these blessings shall come upon you and overtake you, because you heed the voice of the LORD your God.
verses.28:3: Blessed shall you be in the city, and blessed shall you be in the field.
verses.28:4: Blessed shall be the fruit of your womb, and the fruit of your ground, and the fruit of your livestock—the offspring of your herds and the young of your flocks.
verses.28:5: Blessed shall be your basket and your kneading trough.
verses.28:6: Blessed shall you be in your coming in, and blessed shall you be in your going out.
verses.28:7: The LORD will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck down before you; they shall come out against you by one way, and flee before you by seven ways.
verses.28:8: The LORD will command the blessing upon you in your granaries and in all to which you put your hand; and He will bless you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
verses.28:9: The LORD will establish you as a holy people for Himself, just as He swore to you, if you keep the commandments of the LORD your God and walk in His ways.
verses.28:10: Then all the peoples of the earth shall see that the name of the LORD is called upon you, and they shall stand in fear of you.
verses.28:11: And the LORD will make you abound in good—in the fruit of your womb, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground—upon the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.
verses.28:12: The LORD will open to you His good treasury, the heavens, to give the rain of your land in its season and to bless all the work of your hand. And you shall lend to many nations, yet you yourself shall not borrow.
verses.28:13: And the LORD will make you the head and not the tail, and you shall be only above, and you shall not be beneath, if you heed the commandments of the LORD your God that I command you this day, to keep and to do them.
verses.28:14: And you shall not turn aside from any of the words that I command you this day, to the right or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.28:15: But it shall come to pass, if you do not heed the voice of the LORD your God, to keep and to do all His commandments and His statutes that I command you this day, that all these curses shall come upon you and overtake you.
verses.28:16: Cursed shall you be in the city, and cursed shall you be in the field.
verses.28:17: Cursed shall be your basket and your kneading trough.
verses.28:18: Cursed shall be the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your ground, the offspring of your herds and the young of your flocks.
verses.28:19: Cursed shall you be in your coming in, and cursed shall you be in your going out.
verses.28:20: The LORD will send upon you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all to which you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish swiftly, because of the wickedness of your deeds by which you have forsaken Me.
verses.28:21: The LORD will make the pestilence cling to you until He has consumed you from off the land that you are entering to possess.
verses.28:22: The LORD will strike you with wasting disease, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew; and they shall pursue you until you perish.
verses.28:23: And your heavens that are over your head shall be bronze, and the earth that is beneath you shall be iron.
verses.28:24: The LORD will turn the rain of your land into powder and dust; from the heavens it shall come down upon you until you are destroyed.
verses.28:25: The LORD will cause you to be struck down before your enemies; you shall go out against them by one way, and flee before them by seven ways; and you shall become an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.28:26: And your carcass shall be food for every bird of the heavens and for the beasts of the earth, and there shall be no one to frighten them away.
verses.28:27: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with tumors, with scab, and with the itch, from which you cannot be healed.
verses.28:28: The LORD will strike you with madness, and with blindness, and with bewilderment of heart.
verses.28:29: And you shall grope at noonday, just as the blind man gropes in the darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways; and you shall be only oppressed and plundered continually, and there shall be no one to save you.
verses.28:30: You shall betroth a wife, yet another man shall lie with her; you shall build a house, yet you shall not dwell in it; you shall plant a vineyard, yet you shall not enjoy its fruit.
verses.28:31: Your ox shall be slaughtered before your eyes, yet you shall not eat of it; your donkey shall be violently taken away from before your face, and shall not be restored to you; your sheep shall be given to your enemies, and you shall have no one to save you.
verses.28:32: Your sons and your daughters shall be given to another people, and your eyes shall look on and fail with longing for them all the day long, and there shall be no strength in your hand.
verses.28:33: A nation whom you have not known shall eat the fruit of your ground and all your labor, and you shall be only oppressed and crushed continually.
verses.28:34: So you shall be driven mad by the sight of your eyes that you shall behold.
verses.28:35: The LORD will strike you with grievous boils on the knees and on the legs, from which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot even to the crown of your head.
verses.28:36: The LORD will lead you and your king whom you set over yourself to a nation that neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you shall serve other gods—wood and stone.
verses.28:37: And you shall become a horror, a proverb, and a taunt among all the peoples where the LORD will lead you away.
verses.28:38: Much seed you shall carry out to the field, yet little shall you gather in, for the locust shall devour it.
verses.28:39: You shall plant vineyards and till them, yet you shall neither drink the wine nor gather it in, for the worm shall devour them.
verses.28:40: You shall have olive trees throughout all your territory, yet you shall not anoint yourself with oil, for your olives shall drop off.
verses.28:41: You shall father sons and daughters, yet they shall not be yours, for they shall go into captivity.
verses.28:42: The buzzing locust shall possess all your trees and the fruit of your ground.
verses.28:43: The sojourner who is in your midst shall rise above you higher and higher, and you shall sink down lower and lower.
verses.28:44: He shall lend to you, and you shall not lend to him; he shall be the head, and you shall be the tail.
verses.28:45: Moreover, all these curses shall come upon you and pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, because you did not heed the voice of the LORD your God, to keep His commandments and His statutes that He commanded you.
verses.28:46: And they shall be upon you as a sign and a wonder, and upon your descendants forever.
verses.28:47: Because you did not serve the LORD your God with gladness and with goodness of heart for the abundance of all things,
verses.28:48: therefore you shall serve your enemies whom the LORD will send against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in want of all things; and He will put a yoke of iron upon your neck until He has destroyed you.
verses.28:49: The LORD will bring a nation against you from afar, from the end of the earth, as the eagle swoops down—a nation whose tongue you will not understand,
verses.28:50: a nation of fierce countenance, which will neither show regard for the aged nor show favor to the young.
verses.28:51: And it shall eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground until you are destroyed; it shall not leave you grain, new wine, or fresh oil, the offspring of your herds or the young of your flocks, until it has caused you to perish.
verses.28:52: And it shall besiege you within all your gates until your high and fortified walls, in which you trust, come down throughout all your land; indeed, it shall besiege you within all your gates throughout all your land that the LORD your God has given you.
verses.28:53: And you shall eat the fruit of your own womb, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and distress with which your enemy shall distress you.
verses.28:54: The man among you who is tender and exceedingly delicate—his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has left,
verses.28:55: so that he will not give to any of them any of the flesh of his children whom he is eating, because nothing at all is left to him in the siege and distress with which your enemy shall distress you within all your gates.
verses.28:56: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness—her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
verses.28:57: and toward her afterbirth that comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she shall eat them in secret for lack of all things, in the siege and distress with which your enemy shall distress you within your gates.
verses.28:58: If you are not careful to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, to fear this glorious and awesome name, the LORD your God,
verses.28:59: then the LORD will make your plagues and the plagues of your descendants extraordinary—great and enduring plagues, and grievous and enduring sicknesses.
verses.28:60: And He will bring back upon you all the diseases of Egypt, of which you were in dread, and they shall cling to you.
verses.28:61: Also every sickness and every plague that is not written in the book of this law, the LORD will bring upon you until you are destroyed.
verses.28:62: And you shall be left few in number, whereas you had been as the stars of the heavens for multitude, because you did not heed the voice of the LORD your God.
verses.28:63: And it shall come to pass, that just as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good and to multiply you, so the LORD will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you; and you shall be uprooted from off the land that you are entering to possess.
verses.28:64: And the LORD will scatter you among all the peoples, from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth; and there you shall serve other gods, which neither you nor your fathers have known—wood and stone.
verses.28:65: And among those nations you shall find no ease, nor shall there be a resting place for the sole of your foot; but there the LORD will give you a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and anguish of soul.
verses.28:66: And your life shall hang in doubt before you; you shall be in dread night and day, and have no assurance of your life.
verses.28:67: In the morning you shall say, "Oh, that it were evening!" and in the evening you shall say, "Oh, that it were morning!" because of the dread of your heart that you shall dread, and because of the sight of your eyes that you shall behold.
verses.28:68: And the LORD will bring you back to Egypt in ships, by the way of which I said to you, "You shall never see it again." And there you shall offer yourselves for sale to your enemies as male and female servants, yet there shall be no buyer.
verses.28:69: These are the words of the covenant that the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant that He made with them at Horeb.
verses.29:1: And Moses called to all Israel and said to them, "You yourselves have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh and to all his servants and to all his land—
verses.29:2: the great testings which your eyes saw, those great signs and wonders.
verses.29:3: Yet the LORD has not given you a heart to know, nor eyes to see, nor ears to hear, until this day.
verses.29:4: And I led you forty years in the wilderness; your garments did not wear out upon you, and your sandal did not wear out upon your foot.
verses.29:5: You did not eat bread, nor did you drink wine or strong drink, so that you might know that I am the LORD your God.
verses.29:6: And when you came to this place, Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out to meet us in battle, and we struck them down.
verses.29:7: And we took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.
verses.29:8: Therefore you shall keep the words of this covenant and perform them, so that you may prosper in all that you do.
verses.29:9: All of you are standing this day before the LORD your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, every man of Israel,
verses.29:10: your little ones, your wives, and the sojourner who is in the midst of your camps, from the cutter of your wood to the drawer of your water,
verses.29:11: that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God, and into His sworn oath, which the LORD your God makes with you this day,
verses.29:12: in order that He may establish you this day as a people for Himself, and that He may be God to you, just as He spoke to you, and just as He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.29:13: Nor is it with you alone that I am making this covenant and this sworn oath,
verses.29:14: but both with the one who stands here with us this day before the LORD our God, and with the one who is not here with us this day.
verses.29:15: For you yourselves know how we dwelt in the land of Egypt, and how we passed through the midst of the nations through which you passed.
verses.29:16: And you saw their detestable things and their idols—wood and stone, silver and gold—which were among them.
verses.29:17: Beware lest there be among you a man or woman, or family or tribe, whose heart turns away this day from the LORD our God to go and serve the gods of those nations—lest there be among you a root bearing gall and wormwood;
verses.29:18: and it shall come to pass, when he hears the words of this sworn curse, that he blesses himself in his heart, saying, 'Peace shall be mine, even though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart'—to sweep away the watered along with the dry.
verses.29:19: The LORD will not be willing to forgive him; rather, the anger of the LORD and His jealousy shall smoke against that man, and every curse written in this book shall settle upon him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heaven.
verses.29:20: And the LORD shall separate him for calamity from all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this Book of the Law.
verses.29:21: Then the coming generation—your children who shall rise up after you, and the foreigner who shall come from a distant land—shall speak, when they see the plagues of that land and the sicknesses with which the LORD has afflicted it,
verses.29:22: seeing that all its land is brimstone and salt, a burning waste, neither sown nor bringing forth growth, nor does any grass spring up in it, like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in His anger and in His wrath—
verses.29:23: all the nations shall say, 'Why has the LORD done thus to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?'
verses.29:24: Then men shall answer, 'Because they forsook the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which He made with them when He brought them out of the land of Egypt;
verses.29:25: for they went and served other gods and bowed down to them, gods whom they had not known and whom He had not allotted to them.
verses.29:26: Therefore the anger of the LORD burned against that land, to bring upon it every curse written in this book;
verses.29:27: and the LORD uprooted them from their soil in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.'
verses.29:28: The hidden things belong to the LORD our God, but the things revealed are for us and for our children forever, that we may perform all the words of this law."
verses.30:1: And it shall come to pass, when all these things come upon you—the blessing and the curse which I have set before you—and you recall them to your heart among all the nations to which the LORD your God has banished you,
verses.30:2: and you return to the LORD your God and heed His voice, according to all that I command you this day, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.30:3: then the LORD your God shall restore your fortunes and have compassion upon you, and He shall gather you again from all the peoples where the LORD your God has scattered you.
verses.30:4: Even if your banished ones are at the uttermost end of the heavens, from there the LORD your God shall gather you, and from there He shall take you.
verses.30:5: And the LORD your God shall bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you shall possess it; and He shall do good to you and multiply you beyond your fathers.
verses.30:6: Moreover, the LORD your God shall circumcise your heart and the heart of your offspring, to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.
verses.30:7: And the LORD your God shall lay all these curses upon your enemies and upon those who hate you, who persecuted you.
verses.30:8: And you shall again heed the voice of the LORD, and perform all His commandments which I command you this day.
verses.30:9: Then the LORD your God shall cause you to abound in all the work of your hand—in the fruit of your womb, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground—for good; for the LORD shall again rejoice over you for good, just as He rejoiced over your fathers,
verses.30:10: when you heed the voice of the LORD your God, to keep His commandments and His statutes written in this Book of the Law, and when you turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.30:11: For this commandment which I command you this day is not too difficult for you, nor is it far away.
verses.30:12: It is not in heaven, that you should say, "Who shall ascend into heaven for us and fetch it for us, and make us hear it, that we may perform it?"
verses.30:13: Nor is it beyond the sea, that you should say, "Who shall cross over to the far side of the sea for us and fetch it for us, and make us hear it, that we may perform it?"
verses.30:14: Rather, the word is exceedingly near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, so that you may perform it.
verses.30:15: Behold, I have placed before you this day life and good, and death and evil,
verses.30:16: in that I command you this day to love the LORD your God, to walk in His ways, and to keep His commandments, His statutes, and His judgments, so that you may live and multiply; and the LORD your God shall bless you in the land which you are entering to possess.
verses.30:17: But if your heart turns away and you will not listen, and you are drawn astray to bow down to other gods and serve them,
verses.30:18: I declare to you this day that you shall surely perish; you shall not prolong your days upon the land which you are crossing over the Jordan to enter and possess.
verses.30:19: I summon the heavens and the earth as witnesses against you this day: life and death I have placed before you, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, so that you and your offspring may live,
verses.30:20: by loving the LORD your God, by heeding His voice, and by clinging fast to Him; for He is your life and the length of your days, so that you may dwell upon the land which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them.
verses.31:1: Now Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.
verses.31:2: And he said to them, "I am one hundred and twenty years old this day; I am no longer able to go out and come in. And the LORD has said to me, 'You shall not cross over this Jordan.'
verses.31:3: The LORD your God Himself is crossing over before you; He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua himself is crossing over before you, just as the LORD has spoken.
verses.31:4: And the LORD will do to them just as He did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, whom He destroyed.
verses.31:5: And the LORD will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment that I have commanded you.
verses.31:6: Be strong and courageous; do not fear nor be in dread of them, for the LORD your God Himself goes with you; He will not fail you nor forsake you."
verses.31:7: Then Moses summoned Joshua and said to him in the sight of all Israel, "Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with this people into the land that the LORD swore to their fathers to give to them, and you shall cause them to inherit it.
verses.31:8: And the LORD Himself goes before you; He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you; do not fear, nor be dismayed."
verses.31:9: So Moses wrote down this law and delivered it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and to all the elders of Israel.
verses.31:10: And Moses commanded them, saying, "At the end of every seven years, at the appointed time of the year of release, during the Feast of Tabernacles,
verses.31:11: when all Israel comes to appear before the LORD your God in the place that He shall choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
verses.31:12: Assemble the people—the men, the women, the little ones, and your sojourner who is within your gates—that they may hear and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and be careful to perform all the words of this law.
verses.31:13: And their children, who have not known it, shall hear and learn to fear the LORD your God all the days that you live upon the land which you are crossing the Jordan to possess."
verses.31:14: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Behold, the days have drawn near for you to die; summon Joshua, and present yourselves in the tent of meeting, that I may commission him." So Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves in the tent of meeting.
verses.31:15: And the LORD appeared in the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the entrance of the tent.
verses.31:16: And the LORD said to Moses, "Behold, you are about to lie down with your fathers; and this people will rise up and play the harlot after the foreign gods of the land into whose midst they are going, and they will forsake Me and break My covenant which I have made with them.
verses.31:17: Then My wrath shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them and hide My face from them, and they shall be devoured; and many evils and distresses shall befall them, so that they will say in that day, 'Have not these evils befallen us because our God is not in our midst?'
verses.31:18: And I will surely hide My face in that day on account of all the evil that they have done, because they have turned to other gods.
verses.31:19: Now therefore, write down this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel; put it in their mouths, so that this song may serve as a witness for Me against the children of Israel.
verses.31:20: For when I have brought them into the land that I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten and been satisfied and grown fat, then they will turn to other gods and serve them; and they will spurn Me and break My covenant.
verses.31:21: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and distresses have befallen them, that this song shall testify before them as a witness, for it shall not be forgotten from the mouths of their offspring; for I know the inclination that they are devising this day, before I have brought them into the land of which I swore."
verses.31:22: So Moses wrote down this song on that day, and he taught it to the children of Israel.
verses.31:23: Then He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, "Be strong and courageous, for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land that I swore to them; and I will be with you."
verses.31:24: And it came to pass, when Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book until they were completed,
verses.31:25: that Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,
verses.31:26: "Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there as a witness against you.
verses.31:27: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am still alive with you this day, you have been rebellious against the LORD; how much more then after my death!
verses.31:28: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their hearing and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
verses.31:29: For I know that after my death you will surely act corruptly and turn aside from the way that I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days, because you will do what is evil in the sight of the LORD, provoking Him to anger through the work of your hands."
verses.31:30: Then Moses spoke in the hearing of the entire assembly of Israel the words of this song until they were completed.
verses.32:1: Give ear, O heavens, that I may speak; and let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
verses.32:2: May my teaching drop like the rain, may my speech distill like the dew, like gentle rain upon the tender grass, and like abundant showers upon the green herb.
verses.32:3: For I will proclaim the name of the LORD; ascribe greatness to our God.
verses.32:4: The Rock—His work is perfect, for all His ways are justice; a God of faithfulness and without iniquity, righteous and upright is He.
verses.32:5: They have acted corruptly toward Him; they are not His children, because of their blemish—a crooked and twisted generation.
verses.32:6: Is this how you repay the LORD, O foolish and unwise people? Is He not your Father who acquired you? He has made you and established you.
verses.32:7: Remember the days of old; consider the years of generation after generation. Ask your father, and he will declare it to you; ask your elders, and they will tell you.
verses.32:8: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when He divided the sons of mankind, He fixed the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.
verses.32:9: For the LORD's portion is His people; Jacob is the allotted measure of His inheritance.
verses.32:10: He found him in a desert land, and in the howling waste of the wilderness; He encircled him, He cared for him, He guarded him as the apple of His eye.
verses.32:11: Like an eagle that stirs up its nest and hovers over its young, He spread out His wings, He took him, He bore him upon His pinions.
verses.32:12: The LORD alone guided him, and no foreign god was with Him.
verses.32:13: He made him ride upon the heights of the earth, and he ate the produce of the field; He nourished him with honey from the crag, and oil from the flinty rock,
verses.32:14: curds of the herd and milk of the flock, with the fat of lambs and rams of the breed of Bashan, and male goats, with the choicest kernels of wheat; and of the blood of the grape you drank foaming wine.
verses.32:15: But Jeshurun grew fat and kicked; you grew fat, you grew thick, you became gorged. Then he forsook God who made him, and scorned the Rock of his salvation.
verses.32:16: They stirred Him to jealousy with foreign gods; with abominations they provoked Him to anger.
verses.32:17: They sacrificed to demons that were not God, to gods they had never known, new gods that had recently appeared, whom your fathers did not dread.
verses.32:18: You were unmindful of the Rock who fathered you, and you forgot the God who brought you forth.
verses.32:19: And the LORD saw it and spurned them, because of the provocation of His sons and His daughters.
verses.32:20: And He said, "I will hide My face from them; I will see what their end shall be, for they are a perverse generation, children in whom there is no faithfulness.
verses.32:21: They have stirred Me to jealousy with what is not God; they have provoked Me to anger with their vanities. So I will stir them to jealousy with those who are not a people; with a foolish nation I will provoke them to anger.
verses.32:22: For a fire is kindled in My wrath, and burns to the lowest Sheol; it devours the earth and its produce, and sets ablaze the foundations of the mountains.
verses.32:23: I will heap calamities upon them; I will exhaust My arrows against them.
verses.32:24: They shall be wasted with famine, devoured by burning pestilence and bitter destruction; I will also send the teeth of beasts against them, with the venom of creatures crawling in the dust.
verses.32:25: Outside, the sword shall bereave, and within the chambers, terror—both young man and virgin, the nursing infant together with the man of gray hair.
verses.32:26: I said, 'I will scatter them afar; I will make the remembrance of them cease from among mankind,'
verses.32:27: had I not feared the taunt of the enemy, lest their adversaries should misjudge, lest they should say, 'Our hand is triumphant, and it was not the LORD who has done all this.'"
verses.32:28: For they are a nation void of counsel, and there is no understanding in them.
verses.32:29: Oh, that they were wise, that they would comprehend this, that they would discern their latter end!
verses.32:30: How could one pursue a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had surrendered them?
verses.32:31: For their rock is not like our Rock, our enemies themselves being judges.
verses.32:32: For their vine is from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah; their grapes are grapes of poison, and their clusters are bitter.
verses.32:33: Their wine is the venom of serpents, and the cruel poison of cobras.
verses.32:34: "Is this not laid up in store with Me, sealed up within My treasuries?
verses.32:35: Vengeance is Mine, and recompense, for the time when their foot shall slip; for the day of their calamity is near, and the things destined for them hasten swiftly."
verses.32:36: For the LORD will vindicate His people and have compassion on His servants, when He sees that their strength is gone, and there is no one remaining, bond or free.
verses.32:37: And He will say, "Where are their gods, the rock in which they sought refuge,
verses.32:38: who ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up and help you; let them be a shelter over you!
verses.32:39: See now that I, even I, am He, and there is no God beside Me; I put to death and I make alive; I have wounded and I will heal; and there is none who can deliver out of My hand.
verses.32:40: For I lift up My hand to heaven and say, 'As I live forever,
verses.32:41: if I sharpen My flashing sword, and My hand takes hold on judgment, I will render vengeance to My adversaries, and I will repay those who hate Me.
verses.32:42: I will make My arrows drunk with blood, and My sword shall devour flesh—with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the long-haired heads of the enemy.'"
verses.32:43: Rejoice, O nations, with His people; for He will avenge the blood of His servants, and render vengeance to His adversaries, and make atonement for His land and His people.
verses.32:44: So Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the hearing of the people, he and Hoshea the son of Nun.
verses.32:45: And Moses finished speaking all these words to all Israel.
verses.32:46: And he said to them, "Set your hearts upon all the words which I solemnly witness to you today, which you shall command your children to observe carefully—all the words of this law.
verses.32:47: For it is not an empty word for you, because it is your very life; and by this word you shall prolong your days upon the land which you are crossing over the Jordan to possess."
verses.32:48: Then the LORD spoke to Moses that very same day, saying,
verses.32:49: "Go up this mountain of the Abarim, Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, opposite Jericho, and behold the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the children of Israel as a possession.
verses.32:50: And die on the mountain to which you ascend, and be gathered to your people, just as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people,
verses.32:51: because you broke faith with Me in the midst of the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin, because you did not hallow Me in the midst of the children of Israel.
verses.32:52: For you shall see the land from afar, yet you shall not enter there, into the land which I am giving to the children of Israel."
verses.33:1: And this is the blessing with which Moses, the man of God, blessed the children of Israel before his death.
verses.33:2: And he said, "The LORD came from Sinai, and dawned upon them from Seir; He shone forth from Mount Paran, and He came from among the myriads of holy ones; from His right hand went a fiery law for them.
verses.33:3: Indeed, He loves the peoples; all His holy ones are in Your hand; they bow down at Your feet, and each one receives from Your words.
verses.33:4: Moses commanded a law for us, a heritage for the congregation of Jacob.
verses.33:5: And He became King in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, the tribes of Israel together.
verses.33:6: Let Reuben live, and not die, nor let his men be few."
verses.33:7: And this is for Judah, and he said, "Hear, O LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him to his people; let his hands be sufficient for him, and may You be a help to him against his adversaries."
verses.33:8: And of Levi he said, "Let Your Thummim and Your Urim belong to Your godly one, whom You tested at Massah, and with whom You contended at the waters of Meribah;
verses.33:9: who said of his father and of his mother, 'I have not seen him,' nor did he acknowledge his brethren, nor did he know his own children; for they have kept Your word, and they guard Your covenant.
verses.33:10: They shall teach Your ordinances to Jacob, and Your law to Israel; they shall place incense before You, and whole burnt offerings upon Your altar.
verses.33:11: Bless his substance, O LORD, and accept the work of his hands; strike through the loins of those who rise against him, and of those who hate him, so that they may not rise again."
verses.33:12: Of Benjamin he said, "The beloved of the LORD shall dwell securely by Him; He shelters him all the day long, and He dwells between his shoulders."
verses.33:13: And of Joseph he said, "Blessed of the LORD be his land, with the choice gifts of heaven, with the dew, and with the deep that couches beneath,
verses.33:14: with the choice harvest of the sun, and with the choice produce of the months,
verses.33:15: with the finest things of the ancient mountains, and with the choice bounty of the everlasting hills,
verses.33:16: with the choice gifts of the earth and its fullness, and the favor of Him who dwelt in the bush. Let them come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the crown of the head of him who was set apart from his brethren.
verses.33:17: A firstborn bull—majesty is his, and his horns are the horns of a wild ox; with them he shall gore the peoples together, even to the ends of the earth. Such are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and such are the thousands of Manasseh."
verses.33:18: And of Zebulun he said, "Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, and Issachar, in your tents!
verses.33:19: They shall summon peoples to the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness; for they shall draw from the abundance of the seas and the hidden treasures of the sand."
verses.33:20: And of Gad he said, "Blessed is He who enlarges Gad; he dwells like a lion, and tears away the arm, yes, even the crown of the head.
verses.33:21: He chose the first part for himself, for there a commander's portion was reserved; he came with the heads of the people; he carried out the righteousness of the LORD, and His judgments with Israel."
verses.33:22: And of Dan he said, "Dan is a lion's whelp; he shall leap forth from Bashan."
verses.33:23: And of Naphtali he said, "O Naphtali, satisfied with favor, and full of the blessing of the LORD, possess the west and the south."
verses.33:24: And of Asher he said, "Blessed above sons be Asher; let him be favored by his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.
verses.33:25: Your bolts shall be iron and bronze; and as your days are, so shall your strength be."
verses.33:26: "There is none like God, O Jeshurun, who rides across the heavens to your help, and on the clouds in His majesty.
verses.33:27: The eternal God is a dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms; He drove out the enemy from before you, and said, 'Destroy!'
verses.33:28: So Israel dwelt in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, in a land of grain and new wine; indeed, his heavens drop down dew.
verses.33:29: Blessed are you, O Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD, the shield of your help and the sword of your majesty! Your enemies shall cringe before you, and you shall tread upon their high places."
verses.34:1: Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the summit of Pisgah, which is opposite Jericho. And the LORD showed him all the land—Gilead as far as Dan,
verses.34:2: all of Naphtali, the territory of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah to the Western Sea,
verses.34:3: and the Negev, and the plain—the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees—as far as Zoar.
verses.34:4: Then the LORD said to him, "This is the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, 'I will give it to your descendants.' I have let you see it with your own eyes, but you shall not cross over there."
verses.34:5: Thus Moses, the servant of the LORD, died there in the land of Moab at the command of the LORD.
verses.34:6: And He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab, facing Beth Peor; and to this day no one knows his burial place.
verses.34:7: Now Moses was one hundred and twenty years old when he died; his eye had not grown dim, nor had his vigor departed.
verses.34:8: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days; then the days of weeping and mourning for Moses came to an end.
verses.34:9: Now Joshua the son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom, because Moses had laid his hands upon him; so the children of Israel listened to him, and did just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.34:10: And no prophet has arisen since in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,
verses.34:11: in all the signs and wonders that the LORD sent him to perform in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, to all his servants, and to all his land,
verses.34:12: and in all the mighty power and all the great and awesome deeds that Moses performed in the sight of all Israel.

notes.1:1: "Beyond the Jordan" renders the Hebrew expression for the territory across the Jordan River, here referring to the eastern side in the plains of Moab. "Arabah" denotes the Jordan rift valley and its southern arid continuation.
notes.1:17: "Show partiality" translates the Hebrew idiom literally meaning "recognize faces," forbidding judges from favoring any person in court.
notes.1:40: "Red Sea" is the traditional rendering of Hebrew Yam Suph, literally "Sea of Reeds," here pointing toward the northeastern arm of the Red Sea.
notes.1:41: "Deemed it an easy thing" translates a rare Hebrew verb meaning to regard a task as light or to venture forth rashly and presumptuously.
notes.2:11: The Rephaim were an ancient people of great stature who inhabited regions of Transjordan; the Moabite name Emim means "terrors."
notes.2:20: Zamzummim was the Ammonite name for the Rephaim who formerly occupied Ammon, often linked with the Zuzim of Genesis 14:5.
notes.2:24: Hebrew nachal refers to a seasonal stream bed or deep wadi gorge, which also accounts for the reference to a city situated "in the valley" in verse 36.
notes.2:33: The Masoretic text spells "his sons" defectively without the plural yod, though the consonantal and contextual usage represents the plural "his sons."
notes.3:9: Sirion and Senir were the Phoenician and Amorite names respectively for Mount Hermon, attested in ancient Near Eastern texts.
notes.3:11: A standard cubit of a man measured roughly eighteen inches, making Og's iron bedstead approximately thirteen and a half feet long and six feet wide.
notes.3:14: Havvoth Jair means "the tent-villages of Jair."
